decisions.choice: the same words as 1 Kings 8:12
decisions.reason: Verses 1-39 retell Solomon's words and prayer at the dedication of the house as 1 Kings 8:12-50 gives them. This verse is word for word the same as 1 Kings 8:12, and it follows at once on the cloud that filled the house (5:13-14). Where the Hebrew of the two books is the same, the wording here is the same; each record notes how Chronicles differs.

decisions.choice: has said to dwell: has said that he would dwell
decisions.reason: The verb "dwell" is an infinitive after "said". It reports what Yahweh had said about himself; "said" can also mean "decided".

decisions.choice: thick darkness: the dark cloud of Yahweh's presence
decisions.reason: At Sinai Moses drew near to "the thick darkness where God was" (Exodus 20:21; Deuteronomy 4:11; 5:22), and Yahweh appeared in the cloud over the ark's cover (Leviticus 16:2). The cloud that has just filled the house (5:13-14) is that darkness: Yahweh is truly present, yet hidden.

decisions.choice: live in a thick, dark cloud (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 8:12: Readable says "live" for "dwell" and describes the thick darkness as a dark cloud, linking it with the cloud of 5:13-14.

decisions.choice: lines (\q) as the English; no deity_pronoun span on "habitaría"
decisions.reason: As the Spanish of 1 Kings 8:12, whose words this verse repeats: the short poem is set in lines, and the English "he/He" for God is carried by the Spanish verb ending.

decisions.choice: the French Kings wording reused through the prayer (verses 1-39), changed only where the Hebrew of Chronicles differs
decisions.reason: Solomon's words and prayer repeat 1 Kings 8:12-50 (m1); where the Hebrew is the same, every level keeps the French of 1 Kings 8, as the terms note asks. The two-line saying is set in lines at every level, as the English has it.

decisions.choice: the wording and lines of 1 Kings 8:12-13
decisions.reason: Solomon's words in verses 1-2 are the same as 1 Kings 8:12-13 (m1), and keep their Vietnamese at each level; the prayer that follows (verses 14-42) reuses 1 Kings 8:23-53 wherever the Hebrew is the same.

decisions.choice: And I, I have built: Solomon's own part, set beside Yahweh's word
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 8:13 doubles the verb, "I have surely built". Chronicles instead puts the pronoun "I" first: Yahweh said he would dwell in darkness, and Solomon for his part has built him a house. Chronicles also joins the second line with "and". The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: a house of loftiness: an exalted, royal dwelling
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 8:13. The rare word is used of God's "holy and glorious dwelling" in heaven (Isaiah 63:15). In related languages it is a title meaning "prince", so the house is a dwelling fit for a king.

decisions.choice: a place for your dwelling: as Moses sang at the sea
decisions.reason: The same words are used in the Song of the Sea: "the place for your dwelling that you have made, Yahweh, the sanctuary" (Exodus 15:17). Solomon sees the house as the fulfillment of that promise.

decisions.choice: I myself (Balanced); magnificent temple (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced shows the stress the Hebrew puts on "I". Readable keeps the wording of 1 Kings 8:13 and gives the sense of the rare word with a common one.

decisions.choice: "Y yo te he edificado" (L); "Yo mismo" (B)
decisions.reason: Chronicles puts "I" first where 1 Kings 8:13 doubles the verb (meaning decision); Spanish says "yo", "yo mismo" in place of the Kings "Ciertamente".

records.literal_gloss: From the day that I brought out my people from [the] land of Egypt, not I chose a city from all [the] tribes of Israel to build a house for being my name there, and not I chose a man to be ruler over my people Israel.

en.L: 'From the day that I brought {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people out of the land of Egypt, I have not chosen a city from all the tribes of Israel to build a house, for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name to be there; and I have not chosen a man to be ruler over {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel.
en.B: 'Ever since the day I brought {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people out of the land of Egypt, I have chosen no city in any tribe of Israel in which to build a house where {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name would be, and I have chosen no man to be ruler over {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel.
en.R: 'I have not chosen any city in all the tribes of Israel as the place to build a temple for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, not since I brought {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people out of the land of Egypt. And I did not choose any man to lead {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel.

es.L: ‘Desde el día en que saqué a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo de la tierra de Egipto, no he escogido ciudad de entre todas las tribus de Israel para edificar casa en que estuviera allí {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, ni he escogido varón que fuera gobernante sobre {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel.
es.B: ‘Desde el día en que saqué de la tierra de Egipto a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, no he escogido ninguna ciudad en ninguna tribu de Israel para edificar allí una casa donde estuviera {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, ni he escogido a ningún hombre para que fuera gobernante sobre {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel.
es.R: ‘No he escogido ninguna ciudad en todas las tribus de Israel como el lugar para construir un templo para {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, desde que saqué a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo de la tierra de Egipto. Y no escogí a ningún hombre para que guiara a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel.

fr.L: “Depuis le jour où j’ai fait sortir {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple du pays d’Égypte, je n’ai pas choisi de ville parmi toutes les tribus d’Israël pour bâtir une maison où {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom soit ; et je n’ai pas choisi d’homme pour être chef sur {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël.
fr.B: “Depuis le jour où j’ai fait sortir {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple du pays d’Égypte, je n’ai choisi aucune ville, dans aucune tribu d’Israël, pour qu’on y bâtisse une maison où serait {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, et je n’ai choisi aucun homme pour être chef de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël.
fr.R: “Je n’ai choisi aucune ville dans toutes les tribus d’Israël pour y construire un temple pour {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, pas depuis que j’ai fait sortir {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple du pays d’Égypte. Et je n’ai choisi aucun homme pour diriger {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël.

sw.L: 'Tangu siku nilipowatoa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kutoka nchi ya Misri, sikuchagua mji katika makabila yote ya Israeli ili kujenga nyumba, ili jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} liwe huko; wala sikumchagua mtu awe kiongozi juu ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli.
sw.B: 'Tangu siku nilipowatoa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kutoka nchi ya Misri, sikuchagua mji wowote katika kabila lolote la Israeli ili kujenga humo nyumba ambamo jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} lingekaa, wala sikumchagua mtu yeyote awe kiongozi juu ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli.
sw.R: 'Sijachagua mji wowote katika makabila yote ya Israeli kuwa mahali pa kujenga hekalu kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, tangu nilipowatoa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kutoka nchi ya Misri. Wala sikumchagua mtu yeyote kuwaongoza watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli.

vi.L: 'Từ ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đem dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ra khỏi xứ Ai Cập, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chưa chọn thành nào trong tất cả các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên để xây một nhà cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở đó; và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chưa chọn người nào làm người lãnh đạo dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: 'Từ ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đem dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ra khỏi xứ Ai Cập, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chưa chọn thành nào trong các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên để xây một nhà cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ngự ở đó, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng chưa chọn người nào làm người lãnh đạo dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: 'Từ khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đem dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ra khỏi xứ Ai Cập, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chưa chọn thành nào trong tất cả các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên làm nơi xây đền thờ cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Ta cũng chưa chọn người nào để lãnh đạo dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: '내가 내 백성을 이집트 땅에서 이끌어 낸 날부터, 나는 이스라엘의 모든 지파 가운데서 내 이름이 거기 있게 할 집을 지을 성읍을 택하지 않았고, 내 백성 이스라엘 위에 지도자가 될 사람도 택하지 않았다.
ko.B: '내가 내 백성을 이집트 땅에서 이끌어 낸 날부터, 이스라엘의 어느 지파에서도 내 이름을 둘 집을 지으려고 성읍을 택한 적이 없고, 내 백성 이스라엘을 다스릴 지도자로 어떤 사람도 택한 적이 없다.
ko.R: '내가 내 백성을 이집트 땅에서 이끌어 낸 뒤로, 이스라엘의 모든 지파 가운데 어느 성읍도 내 이름을 위한 성전을 지을 곳으로 택하지 않았다. 그리고 내 백성 이스라엘을 이끌 사람도 아무도 택하지 않았다.

decisions.choice: a longer text than 1 Kings 8:16
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 8:16 says "out of Egypt" and goes straight on to the choice of David. Chronicles says "out of the land of Egypt" and has two more sayings: Yahweh chose no man as ruler (this verse) and then chose Jerusalem (verse 6). In both books the choice of a place and the choice of a king belong together.

decisions.choice: for my name to be there: a house where Yahweh is known and called on
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy speaks of the place Yahweh would choose "to put his name there" (Deuteronomy 12:5, 11). His name is Yahweh himself as he has made himself known; where his name is, he is present to hear his people (verses 20-21).

decisions.choice: I did not choose a man to be ruler: no lasting choice before David
decisions.reason: Saul had been made king (1 Chronicles 10), but his rule did not last and no city was chosen with him. The lasting choice of a king came with the choice of Jerusalem (verse 6; 1 Chronicles 17:7).

decisions.choice: ruler (Literal, Balanced); lead (Readable)
decisions.reason: The word *nagid* is "ruler" at Literal and Balanced and "leader" at Readable, as in Samuel and Kings. Readable says "house" as "temple", as in 1 Kings 8.

decisions.choice: "gobernante" (L, B); "guiara" (R)
decisions.reason: *Nagid* follows the Samuel terms note for Spanish, "gobernante" at Literal and Balanced; Readable uses a verb, as the English does (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: "chef" for *nagid*
decisions.reason: The terms note's word for *nagid* in Samuel and Kings; Readable says "diriger", as the English Readable says "lead".

decisions.choice: kiongozi (Literal, Balanced); kuwaongoza (Readable)
decisions.reason: The word *nagid* is "kiongozi" in the Swahili Samuel and Kings drafts, as the Samuel terms note sets.

decisions.choice: "người lãnh đạo" for *nagid*
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note: one word at every level. Chronicles' longer text adds this clause and verse 6 (m1).

decisions.choice: "지도자" for *nagid*
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note; Chronicles' longer text (m1) adds this clause to 1 Kings 8:16.

source.text: וָאֶבְחַר֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם לִהְי֥וֹת שְׁמִ֖י שָׁ֑ם וָאֶבְחַ֣ר בְּדָוִ֔יד לִהְי֖וֹת עַל־עַמִּ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And I have chosen in Jerusalem for being my name there, and I have chosen in David to be over my people Israel.

en.L: But I have chosen Jerusalem for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name to be there, and I have chosen David to be over {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel.'
en.B: But I have chosen Jerusalem as the place where {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name will be, and I have chosen David to rule over {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel.'
en.R: But now I have chosen Jerusalem as the place for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, and I have chosen David to rule over {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Israel.'

es.L: Pero he escogido a Jerusalén para que esté allí {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, y he escogido a David para que esté sobre {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel’.
es.B: Pero he escogido a Jerusalén como el lugar donde estará {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, y he escogido a David para que gobierne a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel’.
es.R: Pero ahora he escogido a Jerusalén como el lugar para {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, y he escogido a David para que gobierne a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo Israel’.

fr.L: Mais j’ai choisi Jérusalem pour que {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom y soit, et j’ai choisi David pour être sur {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël.”
fr.B: Mais j’ai choisi Jérusalem pour que {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom y soit, et j’ai choisi David pour régner sur {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël.”
fr.R: Mais maintenant, j’ai choisi Jérusalem comme le lieu de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, et j’ai choisi David pour régner sur {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple Israël.”

sw.L: Lakini nimeichagua Yerusalemu, ili jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} liwe huko; nami nimemchagua Daudi awe juu ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli.'
sw.B: Lakini nimeichagua Yerusalemu kuwa mahali jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} litakapokaa, nami nimemchagua Daudi atawale watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli.'
sw.R: Lakini sasa nimeichagua Yerusalemu kuwa mahali pa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, nami nimemchagua Daudi atawale watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli.'

vi.L: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã chọn Giê-ru-sa-lem để danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở đó, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã chọn Đa-vít để cai trị dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là Y-sơ-ra-ên.'
vi.B: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã chọn Giê-ru-sa-lem làm nơi danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ngự, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã chọn Đa-vít để cai trị dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là Y-sơ-ra-ên.'
vi.R: Nhưng bây giờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã chọn Giê-ru-sa-lem làm nơi cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã chọn Đa-vít để cai trị dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là Y-sơ-ra-ên.'

ko.L: 그러나 나는 예루살렘을 택하여 내 이름이 거기 있게 했고, 다윗을 택하여 내 백성 이스라엘 위에 있게 했다.'
ko.B: 그러나 나는 예루살렘을 택하여 내 이름을 그곳에 두었고, 다윗을 택하여 내 백성 이스라엘을 다스리게 했다.'
ko.R: 그러나 이제 나는 예루살렘을 내 이름을 둘 곳으로 택했고, 다윗을 택하여 내 백성 이스라엘을 다스리게 했다.'

decisions.choice: I have chosen Jerusalem: not in 1 Kings 8:16
decisions.reason: The choice of Jerusalem is not in the Hebrew of 1 Kings 8:16, which has only "and I chose David". The city and the king are chosen together, as in Psalm 78:68-70 and 132:11-14.

decisions.choice: to be over my people: to rule them
decisions.reason: To be "over" a people is to be their ruler (1 Chronicles 17:7).

decisions.choice: But
decisions.reason: The "and" that opens the verse sets Yahweh's choice against the long time when he chose no city and no man (verse 5).

source.text: וַיְהִ֕י עִם־לְבַ֖ב דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֑י לִבְנ֣וֹת בַּ֔יִת לְשֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was with [the] heart of David my father to build a house for [the] name of Yahweh, [the] God of Israel.

en.L: And it was with the heart of David my father to build a house for the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel.
en.B: My father David had it in his heart to build a house for the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel.
en.R: My father David wanted to build a temple for the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel.

es.L: Y estaba en el corazón de David mi padre edificar casa al nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel.
es.B: Mi padre David tenía en su corazón edificar una casa para el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel.
es.R: Mi padre David quería construir un templo para el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel.

fr.L: Et il était au cœur de David mon père de bâtir une maison pour le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël.
fr.B: Mon père David avait à cœur de bâtir une maison pour le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël.
fr.R: Mon père David voulait construire un temple pour le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël.

sw.L: Na ilikuwa moyoni mwa Daudi baba yangu kujenga nyumba kwa ajili ya jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli.
sw.B: Baba yangu Daudi alikuwa na nia moyoni mwake ya kujenga nyumba kwa ajili ya jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli.
sw.R: Baba yangu Daudi alitaka kujenga hekalu kwa ajili ya jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli.

vi.L: Đa-vít cha ta đã có lòng xây một nhà cho danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Đa-vít cha ta đã có lòng muốn xây một nhà cho danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Đa-vít cha ta đã muốn xây một đền thờ cho danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 위하여 집을 짓는 것이 내 아버지 다윗의 마음에 있었다.
ko.B: 내 아버지 다윗은 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 위하여 집을 지으려는 마음을 품었다.
ko.R: 내 아버지 다윗은 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 위하여 성전을 짓고 싶어 했다.

decisions.choice: the same words as 1 Kings 8:17
decisions.reason: The verse is the same as 1 Kings 8:17, and the wording is the same.

decisions.choice: it was with the heart of David: David intended and longed to do it
decisions.reason: The heart is where plans are made. David told Nathan that he wanted to build a house for the ark (1 Chronicles 17:1-2; 28:2).

decisions.choice: wanted (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable puts the heart idiom in plain words.

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֔י יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר הָיָה֙ עִם־לְבָ֣בְךָ֔ לִבְנ֥וֹת בַּ֖יִת לִשְׁמִ֑י הֱֽטִיב֔וֹתָ כִּ֥י הָיָ֖ה עִם־לְבָבֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Yahweh to David my father, Because that it was with your heart to build a house for my name, you did well that it was with your heart.

en.L: But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to David my father, 'Because it was with your heart to build a house for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, you did well that it was with your heart.
en.B: But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to my father David, 'You wanted to build a house for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, and you did well to have this in your heart.
en.R: But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to my father David, 'You wanted to build a temple for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name. It was good that you wanted to do this.

es.L: Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo a David mi padre: ‘Por cuanto estuvo en tu corazón edificar casa a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, bien hiciste en tenerlo en tu corazón.
es.B: Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a mi padre David: ‘Tú quisiste edificar una casa para {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, e hiciste bien en tener esto en tu corazón.
es.R: Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a mi padre David: ‘Tú querías construir un templo para {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre. Fue bueno que quisieras hacerlo.

fr.L: Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à David mon père : “Puisqu’il était dans ton cœur de bâtir une maison pour {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, tu as bien fait de l’avoir eu à cœur.
fr.B: Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit à mon père David : “Tu as voulu bâtir une maison pour {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, et tu as bien fait d’avoir cela à cœur.
fr.R: Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit à mon père David : “Tu as voulu construire un temple pour {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom. C’était bien de vouloir faire cela.

sw.L: Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Daudi baba yangu, 'Kwa sababu ilikuwa moyoni mwako kujenga nyumba kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, ulifanya vyema kwamba ilikuwa moyoni mwako.
sw.B: Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia baba yangu Daudi, 'Ulitaka kujenga nyumba kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, nawe ulifanya vyema kuwa na nia hiyo moyoni mwako.
sw.R: Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia baba yangu Daudi, 'Ulitaka kujenga hekalu kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}. Ilikuwa vyema kwamba ulitaka kufanya hivyo.

vi.L: Nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Đa-vít cha ta: 'Vì ngươi đã có lòng xây một nhà cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, ngươi có lòng như vậy là tốt.
vi.B: Nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Đa-vít cha ta: 'Con muốn xây một nhà cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}; con có lòng như vậy là tốt.
vi.R: Nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Đa-vít cha ta: 'Con muốn xây một đền thờ cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Con muốn làm điều đó là tốt.

ko.L: 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내 아버지 다윗에게 말씀하셨다. '내 이름을 위하여 집을 짓는 것이 네 마음에 있었으니, 그것이 네 마음에 있었던 것은 잘한 일이다.
ko.B: 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내 아버지 다윗에게 말씀하셨다. '네가 내 이름을 위하여 집을 지으려고 했으니, 그런 마음을 품은 것은 잘한 일이다.
ko.R: 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내 아버지 다윗에게 말씀하셨다. '너는 내 이름을 위하여 성전을 짓고 싶어 했다. 네가 그런 마음을 품은 것은 좋은 일이다.

decisions.choice: the same words as 1 Kings 8:18
decisions.reason: The verse is the same as 1 Kings 8:18, and the wording is the same.

decisions.choice: you did well: Yahweh approves David's desire though he does not let him carry it out
decisions.reason: These words are not in 1 Chronicles 17 or 2 Samuel 7, though they agree with them: Yahweh honors what David wanted and gives the task to his son.

decisions.choice: But
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 8:18: the "and" points to a contrast. David wanted to build, but Yahweh said otherwise.

source.text: רַ֣ק אַתָּ֔ה לֹ֥א תִבְנֶ֖ה הַבָּ֑יִת כִּ֤י בִנְךָ֙ הַיּוֹצֵ֣א מֵֽחֲלָצֶ֔יךָ הֽוּא־יִבְנֶ֥ה הַבַּ֖יִת לִשְׁמִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Only you not will build the house, but your son, the one coming out from your loins, he will build the house for my name.

en.L: Only, you will not build the house; but your son, who will come out of your loins, he will build the house for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name.'
en.B: Yet you are not the one who will build the house. Your son, your own offspring, is the one who will build the house for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name.'
en.R: But you will not be the one to build it. Your own son will build the temple for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name.'

es.L: Solo que tú no edificarás la casa, sino tu hijo, que saldrá de tus lomos, él edificará la casa a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre’.
es.B: Pero no serás tú quien edifique la casa. Tu hijo, tu propia descendencia, es quien edificará la casa para {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre’.
es.R: Pero no serás tú quien la construya. Tu propio hijo construirá el templo para {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre’.

fr.L: Seulement, ce n’est pas toi qui bâtiras la maison ; mais ton fils, qui sortira de tes reins, c’est lui qui bâtira la maison pour {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom.”
fr.B: Pourtant, ce n’est pas toi qui bâtiras la maison. C’est ton fils, né de toi, qui bâtira la maison pour {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom.”
fr.R: Mais ce n’est pas toi qui la construiras. C’est ton propre fils qui construira le temple pour {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom.”

sw.L: Ila wewe hutaijenga nyumba; bali mwanao, atakayetoka viunoni mwako, yeye ndiye atakayeijenga nyumba kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}.'
sw.B: Lakini si wewe utakayeijenga nyumba hiyo. Mwanao, mzao wako mwenyewe, ndiye atakayeijenga nyumba kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}.'
sw.R: Lakini si wewe utakayelijenga. Mwanao mwenyewe atajenga hekalu kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}.'

vi.L: Chỉ có điều ngươi sẽ không xây nhà ấy; nhưng con trai ngươi, là người sẽ ra từ lòng ngươi, chính nó sẽ xây nhà cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.'
vi.B: Tuy nhiên, không phải con sẽ xây nhà ấy. Chính con trai con, do con sinh ra, sẽ xây nhà cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.'
vi.R: Nhưng con sẽ không phải là người xây đền thờ ấy. Chính con trai con sẽ xây đền thờ cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.'

ko.L: 다만 너는 그 집을 짓지 못할 것이다. 오히려 네 허리에서 나올 네 아들, 그가 내 이름을 위하여 그 집을 지을 것이다.'
ko.B: 그러나 그 집을 지을 사람은 네가 아니다. 네 몸에서 날 네 아들이 내 이름을 위하여 그 집을 지을 것이다.'
ko.R: 그러나 너는 성전을 짓지 못할 것이다. 네 친아들이 내 이름을 위하여 성전을 지을 것이다.'

decisions.choice: the same words as 1 Kings 8:19
decisions.reason: The verse is the same as 1 Kings 8:19, except that Kings has a fuller word for "but". The wording is the same.

decisions.choice: who will come out of your loins: your own son
decisions.reason: The loins stand for the body as the source of children (Genesis 35:11). The words echo the promise in 2 Samuel 7:12.

decisions.choice: you will not build the house
decisions.reason: David himself gives the reason in Chronicles: he had shed much blood and fought great wars (1 Chronicles 22:8; 28:3).

decisions.choice: your own offspring (Balanced); your own son (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the picture of the loins in plain words.

source.text: וַיָּ֣קֶם יְהוָ֔ה אֶת־דְּבָר֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֵּ֑ר וָאָק֡וּם תַּחַת֩ דָּוִ֨יד אָבִ֜י וָאֵשֵׁ֣ב׀עַל־כִּסֵּ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כַּאֲשֶׁר֙ דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה וָאֶבְנֶ֣ה הַבַּ֔יִת לְשֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And established Yahweh his word that he spoke, and I have risen in place of David my father, and I sit on [the] throne of Israel as spoke Yahweh, and I have built the house for [the] name of Yahweh, [the] God of Israel.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has established {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} word that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke; and I have risen in place of David my father, and I sit on the throne of Israel, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} spoke; and I have built the house for the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel.
en.B: Now {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has kept the promise {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made. I have taken the place of my father David and sit on Israel's throne, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} promised, and I have built this house for the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel.
en.R: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has kept {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} promise. I have become king after my father David, and I sit on the throne of Israel, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} promised. And I have built the temple for the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha cumplido {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} palabra que habló; y me he levantado en lugar de David mi padre, y me siento en el trono de Israel, como habló {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y he edificado la casa al nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel.
es.B: Ahora {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha cumplido la promesa que hizo. He ocupado el lugar de mi padre David y me siento en el trono de Israel, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo prometió, y he edificado esta casa para el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel.
es.R: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha cumplido {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} promesa. Llegué a ser rey después de mi padre David, y me siento en el trono de Israel, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo prometió. Y he construido el templo para el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a accompli la parole qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait dite ; et je me suis levé à la place de David mon père, et je suis assis sur le trône d’Israël, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait dit ; et j’ai bâti la maison pour le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël.
fr.B: Maintenant, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a tenu la promesse qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait faite. J’ai succédé à mon père David et je siège sur le trône d’Israël, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait promis, et j’ai bâti cette maison pour le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël.
fr.R: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a tenu {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} promesse. Je suis devenu roi après mon père David, et je suis assis sur le trône d’Israël, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait promis. Et j’ai construit le temple pour le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amelithibitisha neno {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} alilolinena; nami nimeinuka mahali pa Daudi baba yangu, nami ninaketi juu ya kiti cha enzi cha Israeli, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyonena; nami nimeijenga nyumba kwa ajili ya jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli.
sw.B: Sasa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameitimiza ahadi aliyoitoa. Nimechukua nafasi ya baba yangu Daudi na kuketi juu ya kiti cha enzi cha Israeli, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyoahidi, nami nimeijenga nyumba hii kwa ajili ya jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli.
sw.R: Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ametimiza ahadi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Nimekuwa mfalme baada ya baba yangu Daudi, nami ninaketi juu ya kiti cha enzi cha Israeli, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyoahidi. Nami nimejenga hekalu kwa ajili ya jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm vững lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán; ta đã dấy lên thay Đa-vít cha ta, và ta ngồi trên ngai Y-sơ-ra-ên như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán; ta cũng đã xây nhà cho danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Nay {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã giữ lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hứa. Ta đã kế vị Đa-vít cha ta và ngồi trên ngai Y-sơ-ra-ên, như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã hứa, và ta đã xây nhà này cho danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã giữ lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hứa. Ta đã làm vua kế vị Đa-vít cha ta, và ta ngồi trên ngai Y-sơ-ra-ên, đúng như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã hứa. Ta cũng đã xây đền thờ cho danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하신 말씀을 이루셨다. 내가 내 아버지 다윗을 대신하여 일어나, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하신 대로 이스라엘의 왕좌에 앉았고, 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 위하여 집을 지었다.
ko.B: 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하신 약속을 지키셨다. 나는 내 아버지 다윗의 뒤를 이어, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 약속하신 대로 이스라엘의 왕좌에 앉았고, 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 위하여 이 집을 지었다.
ko.R: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 약속을 지키셨다. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 약속하신 대로 아버지 다윗의 뒤를 이어 왕이 되어 이스라엘의 왕좌에 앉았다. 그리고 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 위하여 성전을 지었다.

decisions.choice: the same words as 1 Kings 8:20
decisions.reason: The verse is the same as 1 Kings 8:20, and the wording is the same.

decisions.choice: established his word: made his promise stand, kept it
decisions.reason: The verb means "make stand". A word that is made to stand is one that comes true (1 Chronicles 17:23).

decisions.choice: I have risen in place of David: I have become king after him
decisions.reason: To "rise" in someone's place is to succeed him.

decisions.choice: promise; promised (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: "Word" and "spoke" here mean the promise Yahweh made, so Balanced and Readable say "promise".

source.text: וָאָשִׂ֥ים שָׁם֙ אֶת־הָ֣אָר֔וֹן אֲשֶׁר־שָׁ֖ם בְּרִ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּרַ֖ת עִם־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And I have put there the ark, where there [is the] covenant of Yahweh that he made with [the] sons of Israel.

en.L: And I have put the ark there, in which [is] the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made with the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel."
en.B: There I have placed the ark, which holds the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made with the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}."
en.R: In the temple I have put the ark. Inside the ark is the covenant {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} made with the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}."

es.L: Y he puesto allí el arca, en la cual [está] el pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que hizo con los hijos de Israel».
es.B: Allí he colocado el arca, que contiene el pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que hizo con los israelitas».
es.R: En el templo he puesto el arca. Dentro del arca está el pacto que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hizo con los israelitas».

fr.L: Et j’y ai mis l’arche, dans laquelle [est] l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a conclue avec les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël. »
fr.B: J’y ai placé l’arche, qui contient l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, celle qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a conclue avec les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}. »
fr.R: Dans le temple, j’ai mis l’arche. Dans l’arche se trouve l’alliance que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a conclue avec les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}. »

sw.L: Nami nimeliweka huko sanduku, ambamo [mna] agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alilofanya na wana wa Israeli."
sw.B: Huko nimeliweka sanduku lililo na agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alilofanya na Waisraeli."
sw.R: Ndani ya hekalu nimeliweka sanduku. Ndani ya sanduku mna agano ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alifanya na Waisraeli."

vi.L: Ta đã đặt hòm ở đó, trong đó [có] giao ước của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lập với con cái Y-sơ-ra-ên."
vi.B: Tại đó ta đã đặt hòm, là hòm đựng giao ước của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lập với dân Y-sơ-ra-ên."
vi.R: Trong đền thờ, ta đã đặt hòm. Trong hòm có giao ước {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã lập với dân Y-sơ-ra-ên."

ko.L: 그리고 내가 거기에 궤를 두었다. 그 안에는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘 자손과 맺으신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 언약이 [있다]."
ko.B: 나는 거기에 궤를 두었다. 그 궤 안에는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘 자손과 맺으신 언약이 들어 있다."
ko.R: 나는 성전 안에 궤를 두었다. 그 궤 안에는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘 자손과 맺으신 언약이 들어 있다."

decisions.choice: different words from 1 Kings 8:21
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 8:21 says "I have set there a place for the ark" and that the covenant was made "with our fathers when he brought them out of the land of Egypt". Chronicles says "I have put the ark there" and that the covenant was made "with the sons of Israel". Both speak of the covenant made at Sinai.

decisions.choice: the covenant: the stone tablets on which the covenant was written
decisions.reason: What is in the ark is the two tablets (5:10), called "the tablets of the covenant" (Deuteronomy 9:9). The covenant is named for the tablets that record it.

decisions.choice: children of Israel (Literal); Israelites (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The whole people, men and women, are meant, so the inclusive form is the default, as everywhere.

decisions.choice: "los hijos de Israel" (L); "los israelitas" (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: As in 5:2: the Spanish words already take in women, so the English gender span has no Spanish counterpart.

decisions.choice: "이스라엘 자손" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The Korean word covers the whole people, so the English gender setting has no Korean counterpart.

source.text: וַֽיַּעֲמֹ֗ד לִפְנֵי֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח יְהוָ֔ה נֶ֖גֶד כָּל־קְהַ֣ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּפְרֹ֖שׂ כַּפָּֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And he stood before [the] altar of Yahweh in front of all [the] assembly of Israel, and spread out his palms.

en.L: And he stood before the altar of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in front of all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his palms.
en.B: Then Solomon took his place before the altar of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, in front of all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands.
en.R: Then Solomon stood in front of the altar of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, with all the people of Israel there. He held up his open hands to pray.

es.L: Y se puso delante del altar {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, frente a toda la asamblea de Israel, y extendió sus palmas.
es.B: Luego Salomón se puso delante del altar {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, frente a toda la asamblea de Israel, y extendió las manos.
es.R: Luego Salomón se puso de pie delante del altar {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, con todo el pueblo de Israel presente. Levantó las manos abiertas para orar.

fr.L: Et il se tint devant l’autel {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, en face de toute l’assemblée d’Israël, et il étendit ses paumes.
fr.B: Puis Salomon se plaça devant l’autel {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, en face de toute l’assemblée d’Israël, et il étendit les mains.
fr.R: Ensuite, Salomon s’est tenu devant l’autel {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, en présence de tout le peuple d’Israël. Il a levé les mains ouvertes pour prier.

sw.L: Akasimama mbele ya madhabahu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mbele ya kusanyiko lote la Israeli, akainyoosha mikono yake.
sw.B: Kisha Sulemani akasimama mbele ya madhabahu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mbele ya kusanyiko lote la Israeli, akainyoosha mikono yake.
sw.R: Kisha Sulemani akasimama mbele ya madhabahu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, watu wote wa Israeli wakiwepo. Akainua mikono yake iliyokunjuliwa ili kuomba.

vi.L: Vua đứng trước bàn thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, trước mặt cả hội chúng Y-sơ-ra-ên, và giơ hai bàn tay ra.
vi.B: Rồi Sa-lô-môn đứng trước bàn thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, trước mặt cả hội chúng Y-sơ-ra-ên, và giơ hai tay ra.
vi.R: Rồi Sa-lô-môn đứng trước bàn thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, có toàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên ở đó. Vua giơ hai bàn tay ra mà cầu nguyện.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 이스라엘의 온 회중 앞에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 제단 앞에 서서 두 손바닥을 폈다.
ko.B: 그러고 나서 솔로몬은 이스라엘의 온 회중 앞에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 제단 앞에 서서 두 손을 펴 들었다.
ko.R: 그러고 나서 솔로몬은 이스라엘 모든 백성이 보는 앞에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 제단 앞에 섰다. 그리고 기도하려고 두 손을 펴 들었다.

decisions.choice: 1 Kings 8:22 names Solomon and ends "toward the heavens"
decisions.reason: Here the verb has no named subject, and the words "toward the heavens" are held back to the end of verse 13. Chronicles stops to describe the platform Solomon stood on, then repeats "spread out his palms" to take up the story again.

decisions.choice: spread out his palms: the posture of prayer
decisions.reason: People prayed standing or kneeling with open hands lifted up (Exodus 9:29; Isaiah 1:15).

decisions.choice: the altar of Yahweh: the great bronze altar in the courtyard
decisions.reason: This is the bronze altar for burnt offerings that Solomon made (4:1), standing in front of the house (7:7).

records.literal_gloss: For had made Solomon a platform of bronze and had put it in [the] middle of the court, five cubits its length and five cubits its width and cubits three its height, and he stood on it and knelt on his knees in front of all [the] assembly of Israel and spread out his palms toward the heavens.

en.L: For Solomon had made a bronze platform and had put it in the middle of the court, five cubits its length, and five cubits its width, and three cubits its height; and he stood on it, and knelt on his knees in front of all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his palms toward the heavens.
en.B: Solomon had made a bronze platform, {{units:about 7 1/2 feet|five cubits}} long, {{units:about 7 1/2 feet|five cubits}} wide and {{units:about 4 1/2 feet|three cubits}} high, and had set it in the middle of the courtyard. He stood on it, then knelt down in front of the whole assembly of Israel and spread out his hands toward heaven.
en.R: Solomon had made a bronze platform and put it in the middle of the courtyard. It was {{units:about 7 1/2 feet|five cubits}} long, {{units:about 7 1/2 feet|five cubits}} wide and {{units:about 4 1/2 feet|three cubits}} high. He stood on it. Then he knelt down in front of all the people of Israel and held up his hands toward heaven.

Medía {{units:unos 2,25 metros|cinco codos}} de largo, {{units:unos 2,25 metros|cinco codos}} de ancho y {{units:unos 1,35 metros|tres codos}} de alto. Se puso de pie sobre ella. decisions.choice: the bronze platform: not in 1 Kings 8
decisions.reason: Kings has no account of the platform. It says only, at the end of the prayer, that Solomon rose from kneeling before the altar (1 Kings 8:54). Chronicles explains where he stood and knelt so that the whole assembly could see him.

decisions.choice: platform: a raised stand
decisions.reason: The word usually means a basin, like the bronze basins for washing (4:6). Here it is something Solomon stood on, so it is a raised stand, perhaps shaped like a large bowl.

decisions.choice: the court: the great courtyard where the people stood
decisions.reason: The house had the court of the priests and the great court (4:9). The platform stood in the middle of the courtyard, among the people.

decisions.choice: For: the verse explains verse 12
decisions.reason: The verse looks back to explain how Solomon could pray in front of the whole assembly, then repeats "spread out his palms" to return to the moment of prayer.

decisions.choice: about 7 1/2 feet; about 4 1/2 feet (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: A cubit is about 18 inches, so five cubits is about 7 1/2 feet and three cubits about 4 1/2 feet. Literal keeps the cubit; Balanced and Readable give the modern measure with the cubit as the alternative.

decisions.choice: For left out (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable tell the explanation as a new sentence, so the word "for" is not needed.

decisions.choice: "una plataforma"
decisions.reason: The word usually means a basin; here it is something Solomon stood on (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "2.25미터쯤", "1.35미터쯤" (metric); the cubits as the alternative
decisions.reason: The cubit at 45 cm; the verse is not in 1 Kings, so its wording is new.

decisions.choice: 1 Kings 8:23 adds "above" and "beneath"
decisions.reason: Kings says "in the heavens above and on the earth beneath". Chronicles has the shorter "in the heavens and on the earth". The rest of the verse is the same, and the wording is the same.

decisions.choice: there is no God like you: Yahweh has no equal
decisions.reason: Israel confessed that no god could be compared with Yahweh, in heaven or on earth (Exodus 15:11; Deuteronomy 4:39).

decisions.choice: keeping the covenant and the steadfast love: faithful to the covenant and to the love it promises
decisions.reason: The same words describe Yahweh in Deuteronomy 7:9, 12. The word for steadfast love (*chesed*) is the loyal, generous love that keeps its commitments. The two nouns belong together: Yahweh keeps his covenant by showing steadfast love.

decisions.choice: walk before you: live in your sight, serving you
decisions.reason: To walk before Yahweh is to live one's whole life aware of him and obeying him (Genesis 17:1).

decisions.choice: steadfast love, slaves (Literal); faithful love, servants (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: *Chesed* is "steadfast love" at Literal and "faithful love" at Balanced and Readable, as everywhere. Those who serve God are his "slaves" at Literal and "servants" at the other levels, following the rule for *'eved*.

decisions.choice: Solomon prayed (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable names the speaker and says that what follows is a prayer, after the words to the people in verses 4-11.

decisions.choice: "amor leal" (L), "amor fiel" (B, R); "siervos" at every level
decisions.reason: *Ḥesed* follows the Samuel terms note; those who serve God are "siervos" at every level, as the Spanish of 1 Kings 8:23, where the English Literal says "slaves" (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: vocative "SEÑOR" without the article
decisions.reason: Solomon's prayer speaks to God as "{{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}" without the article, and every written pronoun for God carries the deity_pronoun span, as the Spanish of 1 Kings 8.

decisions.choice: "amour loyal", "esclaves" (L); "amour fidèle", "serviteurs" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in French Kings (1 Kings 8:23): *ḥesed* as settled for these books, and God's servants in general are "esclaves" at Literal, while a named servant such as David is "serviteur" at every level.

decisions.choice: upendo usiokoma (Literal); fadhili (Balanced, Readable); watumishi (all levels)
decisions.reason: *Ḥesed* is "upendo usiokoma" at Literal and "fadhili" at Balanced and Readable, as the Samuel terms note and the Swahili 1 Kings 8:23; God's servants are "watumishi" at every level, as in the Swahili Kings.

decisions.choice: "tình yêu thương thành tín"; "các đầy tớ của Ngài" at every level
decisions.reason: The wording of 1 Kings 8:23. Those who serve God are "đầy tớ" at every level, Literal included, where the English Literal says "slaves"; so too for "your servant David" and Solomon's "your servant" through this prayer.

decisions.choice: Solomon prays in 합쇼체 to "주님", calling himself "주님의 종" and "저"; "한결같은 사랑" (L), "인애" (B, R); "종" at every level
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 8:23; "하나님" here because Chronicles has "God" where Kings has "god" with "above" and "beneath" (m1).

en.R: You have kept the promise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, my father David. What {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} said with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} mouth, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand, as we see today.

es.R: Tú has cumplido la promesa que le hiciste a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo, mi padre David. Lo que dijiste con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} boca, lo has hecho con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano, como vemos hoy.

De {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bouche {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’avais promis, et de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’as accompli, comme on le voit aujourd’hui.

sw.R: Umetimiza ahadi uliyompa mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, baba yangu Daudi. Ulichosema kwa kinywa {{deity_pronoun:chako|Chako}}, umekitenda kwa mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, kama tunavyoona leo.

vi.L: là Đấng đã giữ cho đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đa-vít cha con điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán với người; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã dùng miệng mà phán, và đã dùng tay mà làm trọn, như [ngày] hôm nay.
vi.B: là Đấng đã giữ lời hứa với đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đa-vít cha con. Ngài đã chính miệng hứa, và đã chính tay làm trọn, như ngày hôm nay.
vi.R: Ngài đã giữ lời hứa với đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đa-vít cha con. Điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hứa bằng miệng, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm bằng tay, như chúng con thấy hôm nay.
