source.text: וְעַתָּ֞ה יְהוָ֣ה׀אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל שְׁ֠מֹר לְעַבְדְּךָ֨דָוִ֤יד אָבִי֙ אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבַּ֤רְתָּ לּוֹ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹא־יִכָּרֵ֨ת לְךָ֥ אִישׁ֙ מִלְּפָנַ֔י יוֹשֵׁ֖ב עַל־כִּסֵּ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רַ֠ק אִם־יִשְׁמְר֨וּ בָנֶ֜יךָ אֶת־דַּרְכָּ֗ם לָלֶ֨כֶת֙ בְּת֣וֹרָתִ֔י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלַ֖כְתָּ לְפָנָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And now, Yahweh, God of Israel, keep for your servant David my father what you spoke to him, saying, Not will be cut off for you a man from before me sitting on [the] throne of Israel, only if keep your sons their way to walk in my law as you walked before me.

en.L: And now, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, God of Israel, keep for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} slave David my father what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} spoke to him, saying, 'There shall not be cut off for you a man from before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} sitting on the throne of Israel, if only your sons keep their way, to walk in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} law as you have walked before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.'
en.B: Now, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, God of Israel, keep for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, my father David, the promise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made to him: 'You will never lack a man of your line sitting before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} on the throne of Israel, as long as your descendants watch how they live and walk in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} law as you have walked before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.'
en.R: Now, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, God of Israel, keep the promise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, my father David. You told him, 'If your descendants are careful to live by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} law, as you have lived before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, one of your family will always sit on the throne of Israel before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.'

es.L: Y ahora, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel, guarda a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo David mi padre lo que le dijiste, diciendo: ‘No te faltará varón delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} que se siente en el trono de Israel, con tal que tus hijos guarden su camino para andar en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ley, como tú has andado delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}’.
es.B: Ahora, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel, cumple a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo, mi padre David, la promesa que le hiciste: ‘Nunca te faltará un hombre de tu linaje que se siente delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} en el trono de Israel, con tal que tus descendientes cuiden su conducta y anden en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ley como tú has andado delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}’.
es.R: Ahora, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel, cumple la promesa que le hiciste a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo, mi padre David. Le dijiste: ‘Si tus descendientes tienen cuidado de vivir según {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ley, como tú has vivido delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, siempre habrá uno de tu familia sentado en el trono de Israel delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}’.

fr.L: Et maintenant, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, Dieu d’Israël, garde envers {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur David mon père ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} lui as dit : “Il ne te sera pas retranché devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} un homme assis sur le trône d’Israël, pourvu seulement que tes fils gardent leur chemin pour marcher dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} loi comme tu as marché devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.”
fr.B: Maintenant, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, Dieu d’Israël, tiens envers {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, mon père David, la promesse que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} lui as faite : “Tu ne manqueras jamais d’un homme de ta lignée qui siège devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} sur le trône d’Israël, pourvu que tes descendants veillent sur leur conduite et marchent selon {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} loi comme tu as marché devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.”
fr.R: Maintenant, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, Dieu d’Israël, tiens la promesse que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as faite à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, mon père David. Tu lui as dit : “Si tes descendants font bien attention à vivre selon {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} loi, comme tu as vécu devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, il y aura toujours quelqu’un de ta famille assis devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} sur le trône d’Israël.”

sw.L: Basi sasa, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, umtimizie mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Daudi baba yangu yale uliyomwambia, ukisema, 'Hutakosa mtu mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} wa kuketi juu ya kiti cha enzi cha Israeli, ikiwa tu wana wako wataishika njia yao, kwenda katika sheria {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} kama wewe ulivyokwenda mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.'
sw.B: Sasa, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, mtimizie mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, baba yangu Daudi, ahadi uliyompa: 'Hutakosa kamwe mtu wa ukoo wako wa kuketi mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} juu ya kiti cha enzi cha Israeli, ikiwa wazao wako watakuwa waangalifu jinsi wanavyoishi na kuenenda katika sheria {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} kama wewe ulivyoenenda mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.'
sw.R: Sasa, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, timiza ahadi uliyompa mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, baba yangu Daudi. Ulimwambia, 'Wazao wako wakiwa waangalifu kuishi kwa kufuata sheria {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} kama wewe ulivyoishi mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, mtu wa jamaa yako ataketi daima juu ya kiti cha enzi cha Israeli mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.'

vi.L: Vậy bây giờ, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, xin giữ cho đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đa-vít cha con điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán với người rằng: 'Ngươi sẽ không bao giờ thiếu người ngồi trên ngai Y-sơ-ra-ên trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, miễn là các con cháu ngươi giữ đường lối mình, bước đi trong luật pháp {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} như ngươi đã bước đi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.'
vi.B: Vậy bây giờ, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, xin giữ lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hứa với đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đa-vít cha con: 'Dòng dõi con sẽ không bao giờ thiếu người ngồi trên ngai Y-sơ-ra-ên trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, miễn là con cháu con cẩn thận về nếp sống mình và bước đi trong luật pháp {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} như con đã bước đi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.'
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, bây giờ xin giữ lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hứa với đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đa-vít cha con. Ngài đã phán với người: 'Nếu con cháu con cẩn thận sống theo luật pháp {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} như con đã sống trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, thì gia đình con sẽ luôn có người ngồi trên ngai Y-sơ-ra-ên trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.'

ko.L: 그리고 이제 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 주님의 종, 제 아버지 다윗에게 말씀하신 것을 그에게 지켜 주십시오. 주님께서는 '네 아들들이 자기 길을 지켜 네가 내 앞에서 걸은 것처럼 내 율법 안에서 걷기만 하면, 내 앞에서 이스라엘의 왕좌에 앉을 사람이 네게서 끊어지지 않을 것이다' 하고 말씀하셨습니다.
ko.B: 이제 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 주님의 종인 제 아버지 다윗에게 하신 약속을 지켜 주십시오. 주님께서는 '네 자손이 자기 행실을 삼가서 네가 내 앞에서 산 것처럼 내 율법대로 살기만 하면, 내 앞에서 이스라엘의 왕좌에 앉을 사람이 네 집안에서 끊어지지 않을 것이다' 하고 약속하셨습니다.
ko.R: 이제 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 주님의 종인 제 아버지 다윗에게 하신 약속을 지켜 주십시오. 주님께서는 그에게 '네 자손들이 너처럼 조심하여 내 율법대로 살면, 네 집안에서 언제나 누군가가 내 앞에서 이스라엘의 왕좌에 앉을 것이다' 하고 말씀하셨습니다.

decisions.choice: to walk in my law: 1 Kings 8:25 has "to walk before me"
decisions.reason: Kings has "to walk before me as you have walked before me". Chronicles says "to walk in my law": walking before Yahweh means living by his written instruction. The rest of the verse is the same, and the wording is the same.

decisions.choice: a man will not be cut off for you: you will never lack a descendant on the throne
decisions.reason: The promise goes back to 1 Chronicles 17:11-14 and 2 Samuel 7:12-16. Yahweh repeats it to Solomon in 7:18.

decisions.choice: only if: the promise is joined to a condition
decisions.reason: Yahweh's promise to David stands, but each king's place on the throne depends on keeping Yahweh's law.

decisions.choice: my law: Yahweh's instruction
decisions.reason: The word *torah* means teaching or instruction, the whole of what Yahweh taught his people through Moses.

decisions.choice: slave, sons (Literal); servant, descendants (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 14 for "slave". "Sons" here means all of David's line, so Balanced and Readable say "descendants".

decisions.choice: "andar en mi ley"
decisions.reason: Chronicles says "to walk in my law" where 1 Kings 8:25 has "before me" (meaning decision); Spanish follows the change and keeps the rest of the Kings wording.

decisions.choice: "bước đi trong luật pháp Ta" where 1 Kings 8:25 has "bước đi trước mặt Ta"
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "to walk in my law" (m1); otherwise the Vietnamese of 1 Kings 8:25.

decisions.choice: "내 율법 안에서 걷기만" (L), "내 율법대로" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Chronicles says "in my law" where 1 Kings 8:25 says "before me" (m1); only that phrase changes.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֕ה יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יֵֽאָמֵן֙ דְּבָ֣רְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ לְעַבְדְּךָ֥ לְדָוִֽיד׃

records.literal_gloss: And now, Yahweh, God of Israel, let be confirmed your word that you spoke to your servant, to David.

en.L: And now, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, God of Israel, let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word be confirmed, which {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} spoke to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} slave, to David.
en.B: So now, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, God of Israel, let the promise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant David be confirmed.
en.R: So now, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, God of Israel, make the promise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant David come true.

es.L: Y ahora, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel, que se confirme {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} palabra que dijiste a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo, a David.
es.B: Así que ahora, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel, que se confirme la promesa que le hiciste a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo David.
es.R: Así que ahora, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel, haz que se cumpla la promesa que le hiciste a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo David.

fr.L: Et maintenant, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, Dieu d’Israël, que {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole soit confirmée, celle que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as dite à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, à David.
fr.B: Maintenant donc, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, Dieu d’Israël, que s’affermisse la promesse que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as faite à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur David.
fr.R: Maintenant donc, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, Dieu d’Israël, réalise la promesse que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as faite à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur David.

sw.L: Basi sasa, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} na lithibitike, ulilomwambia mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Daudi.
sw.B: Basi sasa, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, ahadi uliyompa mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Daudi na ithibitike.
sw.R: Basi sasa, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, ifanye ahadi uliyompa mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Daudi itimie.

vi.L: Vậy bây giờ, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, xin cho lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được xác nhận, là lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán với đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, với Đa-vít.
vi.B: Vậy giờ đây, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, xin cho lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hứa với đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đa-vít được vững bền.
vi.R: Vậy giờ đây, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, xin làm cho lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hứa với đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đa-vít trở thành sự thật.

ko.L: 그리고 이제 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 주님의 종 다윗에게 하신 주님의 말씀이 부디 굳게 서게 해 주십시오.
ko.B: 그러니 이제 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 주님의 종 다윗에게 하신 약속이 그대로 이루어지게 해 주십시오.
ko.R: 그러니 이제 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 주님의 종 다윗에게 하신 약속이 꼭 이루어지게 해 주십시오.

decisions.choice: small differences from 1 Kings 8:26
decisions.reason: Kings has "And now, God of Israel, please let ... be confirmed" and "your servant David my father". Chronicles adds the name Yahweh, has no "please", and says "to your servant, to David".

decisions.choice: be confirmed: be shown to be firm and true
decisions.reason: The verb is related to the word "amen". Solomon asks that the promise be proved reliable by being kept for generations (1 Chronicles 17:23-24).

decisions.choice: slave (Literal); servant (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 14.

source.text: כִּ֚י הַֽאֻמְנָ֔ם יֵשֵׁ֧ב אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת־הָאָדָ֖ם עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ הִ֠נֵּה שָׁמַ֜יִם וּשְׁמֵ֤י הַשָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ לֹ֣א יְכַלְכְּל֔וּךָ אַ֕ף כִּֽי־הַבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנִֽיתִי׃

records.literal_gloss: For truly will dwell God with the humankind on the earth? Look, [the] heavens and [the] heavens of the heavens not contain you; how much less the house the this that I have built!

en.L: But will God truly dwell with humankind on the earth? Look, the heavens and the heavens of the heavens cannot contain {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; how much less this house that I have built!
en.B: But will God really live on earth with human beings? Heaven itself, even the highest heaven, cannot contain {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. How much less this house that I have built!
en.R: But can God really live on earth with people? Even the sky and the highest heaven cannot hold {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. So this temple I have built certainly cannot hold {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}!

es.L: Pero ¿de veras habitará Dios con el ser humano sobre la tierra? He aquí, los cielos y los cielos de los cielos no te pueden contener; ¡cuánto menos esta casa que yo he edificado!
es.B: Pero ¿de verdad vivirá Dios en la tierra con los seres humanos? Ni el cielo, ni siquiera el más alto de los cielos, te puede contener. ¡Cuánto menos esta casa que he edificado!
es.R: Pero ¿puede Dios realmente vivir en la tierra con la gente? Ni siquiera el cielo y el más alto de los cielos te pueden contener. ¡Así que este templo que he construido de ninguna manera te puede contener!

fr.L: Mais Dieu habiterait-il vraiment avec l’homme sur la terre ? Voici, les cieux et les cieux des cieux ne peuvent {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} contenir ; combien moins cette maison que j’ai bâtie !
fr.B: Mais Dieu habiterait-il vraiment sur la terre avec les humains ? Le ciel lui-même, même le plus haut des cieux, ne peut {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} contenir. Combien moins cette maison que j’ai bâtie !
fr.R: Mais Dieu peut-il vraiment habiter sur la terre avec les hommes ? Même le ciel et le plus haut des cieux ne peuvent pas {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} contenir. Alors ce temple que j’ai construit ne peut certainement pas {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} contenir !

sw.L: Lakini je, kweli Mungu atakaa pamoja na wanadamu duniani? Tazama, mbingu na mbingu za mbingu haziwezi kukutosha; sembuse nyumba hii niliyoijenga!
sw.B: Lakini je, kweli Mungu ataishi duniani pamoja na wanadamu? Mbingu zenyewe, hata mbingu za juu kabisa, haziwezi kukutosha. Sembuse nyumba hii niliyoijenga!
sw.R: Lakini je, kweli Mungu anaweza kuishi duniani pamoja na watu? Hata anga na mbingu za juu kabisa haziwezi kukutosha. Basi hekalu hili nililojenga hakika haliwezi kukutosha!

vi.L: Nhưng Đức Chúa Trời có thật sẽ ngự với loài người trên đất chăng? Kìa, trời và trời của các tầng trời còn không thể chứa {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, huống chi ngôi nhà con đã xây này!
vi.B: Nhưng Đức Chúa Trời có thật sẽ ngự với loài người trên đất chăng? Ngay cả trời, cả đến trời cao nhất, cũng không thể chứa {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, huống chi ngôi nhà con đã xây này!
vi.R: Nhưng Đức Chúa Trời có thể thật sự ngự trên đất với loài người sao? Ngay cả bầu trời và tầng trời cao nhất cũng không thể chứa {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Vậy đền thờ con đã xây này chắc chắn không thể chứa {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!

ko.L: 그러나 하나님께서 참으로 땅에서 사람과 함께 계시겠습니까? 보십시오, 하늘과 하늘들의 하늘도 주님을 담을 수 없는데, 하물며 제가 지은 이 집이겠습니까!
ko.B: 그러나 하나님께서 정말로 땅에서 사람과 함께 계시겠습니까? 하늘도, 가장 높은 하늘도 주님을 모실 수 없는데, 하물며 제가 지은 이 집이야 더 말할 것이 있겠습니까!
ko.R: 그러나 하나님께서 정말로 땅에서 사람들과 함께 사실 수 있겠습니까? 하늘도, 가장 높은 하늘도 주님을 다 담을 수 없습니다. 그러니 제가 지은 이 성전은 더욱 주님을 담을 수 없습니다!

decisions.choice: with humankind: not in 1 Kings 8:27
decisions.reason: Kings asks "will God truly dwell on the earth?" Chronicles adds "with humankind". Otherwise the verse is the same, and the wording is the same.

decisions.choice: God is not confined to the house
decisions.reason: Solomon has just said that he built a place for Yahweh to dwell forever (verse 2). Now he says that no place can contain him. The house is where Yahweh puts his name and hears prayer (verses 20-21), while he himself dwells in heaven (2:5).

decisions.choice: the heavens of the heavens: the highest heaven
decisions.reason: This is a superlative, like "holy of holies", as in Deuteronomy 10:14.

decisions.choice: certainly cannot hold you (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable completes the comparison "how much less" in plain words.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span on "te"
decisions.reason: The English "You" is the clitic "te" in Spanish, which carries no span, as in the Spanish of 1 Kings 8:27.

source.text: וּפָנִ֜יתָ אֶל־תְּפִלַּ֧ת עַבְדְּךָ֛ וְאֶל־תְּחִנָּת֖וֹ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י לִשְׁמֹ֤עַ אֶל־הָרִנָּה֙ וְאֶל־הַתְּפִלָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַבְדְּךָ֖ מִתְפַּלֵּ֥ל לְפָנֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And turn to [the] prayer of your servant and to his plea, Yahweh my God, to listen to the cry and to the prayer that your servant [is] praying before you,

en.L: Yet turn to the prayer of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant and to his plea, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} my God, to listen to the cry and to the prayer that {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant is praying before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}},
en.B: Yet listen to the prayer of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant and to his plea for mercy, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} my God. Hear the cry and the prayer that {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant prays before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}},
en.R: But please pay attention to my prayer, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} my God. I am {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, and I am asking for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} help. Listen to the cry and the prayer I am praying to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

es.L: Atiende, pues, a la oración de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo y a su súplica, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios mío, para oír el clamor y la oración que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo hace delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}},
es.B: Aun así, escucha la oración de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo y su súplica, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios mío. Oye el clamor y la oración que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo hace delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}},
es.R: Pero, por favor, presta atención a mi oración, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios mío. Yo soy {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo, y te pido {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ayuda. Escucha el clamor y la oración que te hago.

fr.L: Tourne-toi pourtant vers la prière de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur et vers sa supplication, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, pour écouter le cri et la prière que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur prie devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}},
fr.B: Sois pourtant attentif à la prière de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur et à sa supplication, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu. Écoute le cri et la prière que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}adresse,
fr.R: Mais s’il {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} plaît, sois attentif à ma prière, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu. Je suis {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, et je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} demande {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} aide. Écoute le cri et la prière que je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}adresse.

sw.L: Lakini geukia sala ya mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} na dua yake, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, usikilize kilio na sala ambayo mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} anaiomba mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}},
sw.B: Lakini sikiliza sala ya mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} na dua yake ya rehema, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu. Sikia kilio na sala anayoiomba mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}},
sw.R: Lakini tafadhali isikilize sala yangu, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu. Mimi ni mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, nami ninaomba msaada {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}. Sikiliza kilio na sala ninayokuomba.

vi.L: Dù vậy, xin đoái đến lời cầu nguyện và lời nài xin của đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của con, để nghe tiếng kêu cầu và lời cầu nguyện mà đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang cầu nguyện trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},
vi.B: Dù vậy, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của con, xin lắng nghe lời cầu nguyện và lời nài xin thương xót của đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Xin nghe tiếng kêu cầu và lời cầu nguyện đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dâng lên trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},
vi.R: Nhưng lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của con, xin lắng nghe lời cầu nguyện của con. Con là đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và con đang xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giúp đỡ. Xin nghe tiếng kêu cầu và lời cầu nguyện con dâng lên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 제 하나님, 주님의 종의 기도와 간구를 돌아보시고, 주님의 종이 주님 앞에서 드리는 부르짖음과 기도를 들어 주십시오.
ko.B: 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 제 하나님, 이 종의 기도와 간구를 돌아보아 주십시오. 이 종이 주님 앞에서 부르짖으며 드리는 기도를 들어 주십시오.
ko.R: 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 제 하나님, 제 기도에 귀를 기울여 주십시오. 저는 주님의 종이며, 주님의 도우심을 구합니다. 제가 주님께 부르짖으며 드리는 기도를 들어 주십시오.

decisions.choice: 1 Kings 8:28 adds "today"
decisions.reason: Kings ends "is praying before you today". Chronicles leaves out "today". Otherwise the verse is the same, and the wording is the same.

decisions.choice: prayer, plea, cry: three words for asking God
decisions.reason: The first is the general word for prayer. The second is a plea for favor or mercy. The third (*rinnah*) is a loud cry, often of joy, here of urgent asking.

decisions.choice: turn to: give attention to
decisions.reason: To turn toward a prayer is to take notice of it and respond (Psalm 102:18).

decisions.choice: your servant (all levels); me, I (Readable)
decisions.reason: Solomon speaks of himself politely as "your servant". The words stay "your servant" at every level, as in 1 Kings 8:28; Readable also says "me" and "I" so that it is clear Solomon means himself.

source.text: לִהְיוֹת֩ עֵינֶ֨יךָ פְתֻח֜וֹת אֶל־הַבַּ֤יִת הַזֶּה֙ יוֹמָ֣ם וָלַ֔יְלָה אֶל־הַ֨מָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֔רְתָּ לָשׂ֥וּם שִׁמְךָ֖ שָׁ֑ם לִשְׁמ֨וֹעַ֙ אֶל־הַתְּפִלָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִתְפַּלֵּ֣ל עַבְדְּךָ֔ אֶל־הַמָּק֖וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: for being your eyes open toward the house the this by day and night, toward the place where you said to put your name there, to listen to the prayer that prays your servant toward the place the this.

en.L: that {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} eyes may be open toward this house day and night, toward the place of which {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} said [that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} would] put {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name there, to listen to the prayer that {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant prays toward this place.
en.B: so that day and night {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} eyes may be open toward this house, the place where {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} said {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} would put {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name. Listen to the prayer that {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant prays toward this place.
en.R: Watch over this temple day and night. You said that this is the place where {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} would put {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name. So listen when I, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, pray toward this place.

es.L: para que {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} ojos estén abiertos sobre esta casa de día y de noche, sobre el lugar del cual dijiste [que] pondrías allí {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre, para oír la oración que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo haga hacia este lugar.
es.B: para que de día y de noche {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} ojos estén abiertos sobre esta casa, el lugar donde dijiste que pondrías {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre. Escucha la oración que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo haga hacia este lugar.
es.R: Vigila este templo de día y de noche. Tú dijiste que este es el lugar donde pondrías {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre. Así que escúchame cuando yo, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo, ore hacia este lugar.

fr.L: afin que {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} yeux soient ouverts sur cette maison jour et nuit, sur le lieu dont {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as dit [que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}] y mettrais {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, pour écouter la prière que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur prie vers ce lieu.
fr.B: afin que, jour et nuit, {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} yeux soient ouverts sur cette maison, le lieu où {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as dit que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mettrais {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom. Écoute la prière que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur adresse vers ce lieu.
fr.R: Veille sur ce temple jour et nuit. Tu as dit que c’est l’endroit où {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mettrais {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom. Alors écoute quand moi, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, je prie en me tournant vers ce lieu.

sw.L: ili macho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yawe wazi kuelekea nyumba hii mchana na usiku, kuelekea mahali ulipopasema [kwamba utaweka] jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} huko, kusikiliza sala ambayo mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} anaiomba akielekea mahali hapa.
sw.B: ili mchana na usiku macho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yawe wazi kuelekea nyumba hii, mahali ulipopasema kwamba utaliweka jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}. Sikiliza sala ambayo mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} anaiomba akielekea mahali hapa.
sw.R: Liangalie hekalu hili mchana na usiku. Wewe ulisema kwamba hapa ndipo mahali utakapoliweka jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}. Basi unisikilize mimi mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} ninapoomba nikielekea mahali hapa.

vi.L: để mắt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mở ra hướng về nhà này ngày đêm, hướng về nơi mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán [rằng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ] đặt danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở đó, để nghe lời cầu nguyện mà đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cầu nguyện hướng về nơi này.
vi.B: để ngày đêm mắt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đoái xem nhà này, là nơi mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán rằng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ đặt danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tại đó. Xin nghe lời cầu nguyện đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dâng lên hướng về nơi này.
vi.R: Xin ngày đêm trông nom đền thờ này. Ngài đã phán rằng đây là nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ đặt danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Vậy khi con, là đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, cầu nguyện hướng về nơi này, xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lắng nghe.

ko.L: 주님의 눈이 밤낮으로 이 집을 향하여, 주님께서 주님의 이름을 거기에 두겠다고 말씀하신 곳을 향하여 열려 있어서, 주님의 종이 이곳을 향하여 드리는 기도를 들어 주십시오.
ko.B: 주님께서 주님의 이름을 두겠다고 말씀하신 이 집을 향하여 밤낮으로 눈을 뜨고 계셔서, 이 종이 이곳을 향하여 드리는 기도를 들어 주십시오.
ko.R: 밤낮으로 이 성전을 지켜보아 주십시오. 주님께서는 이곳에 주님의 이름을 두시겠다고 말씀하셨습니다. 그러니 주님의 종인 제가 이곳을 향하여 기도할 때 들어 주십시오.

decisions.choice: small differences from 1 Kings 8:29
decisions.reason: Kings says "night and day" and quotes Yahweh directly: "My name shall be there". Chronicles says "day and night" and "where you said you would put your name", the words of Deuteronomy 12:5. The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: your eyes open: watching over it with care
decisions.reason: Yahweh's eyes are on the land he cares for (Deuteronomy 11:12), and here on the house and those who pray there.

decisions.choice: toward this place: praying while facing the house, even from far away
decisions.reason: The prayer expects people to pray toward the house when they cannot come to it (verses 26, 29, 34, 38). Daniel prayed in Babylon with his windows open toward Jerusalem (Daniel 6:11).

decisions.choice: your servant (all levels); I (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 19.

decisions.choice: "dijiste [que] pondrías" (L); "dijiste que pondrías" (B), with no span on the verb
decisions.reason: Chronicles reports Yahweh's words where 1 Kings 8:29 quotes them (meaning decision); the English "you" in the reported clause is the Spanish verb ending, with no written pronoun to span.

source.text: וְשָׁ֨מַעְתָּ֜ אֶל־תַּחֲנוּנֵ֤י עַבְדְּךָ֙ וְעַמְּךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִֽתְפַּֽלְל֖וּ אֶל־הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וְ֠אַתָּה תִּשְׁמַ֞ע מִמְּק֤וֹם שִׁבְתְּךָ֙ מִן־הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְשָׁמַעְתָּ֖ וְסָלָֽחְתָּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And listen to [the] pleas of your servant and of your people Israel, which they pray toward the place the this; and you, hear from [the] place of your dwelling, from the heavens, and hear and forgive.

en.L: And listen to the pleas of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant and of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people Israel when they pray toward this place; and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, hear from the place of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} dwelling, from the heavens; and hear and forgive.
en.B: Listen to the pleading of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people Israel as they pray toward this place. Hear from heaven, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} dwelling place; and when {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} hear, forgive.
en.R: Listen when I, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people Israel ask for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} help as we pray toward this place. Listen from heaven, where {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} live. And when {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} hear, forgive.

es.L: Y escucha las súplicas de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo y de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo Israel cuando oren hacia este lugar; y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, escucha desde el lugar de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} morada, desde los cielos; escucha y perdona.
es.B: Escucha las súplicas de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo y de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo Israel cuando oren hacia este lugar. Escucha desde el cielo, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} morada, y cuando escuches, perdona.
es.R: Escucha cuando yo, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo, y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo Israel te pidamos ayuda orando hacia este lugar. Escucha desde el cielo, donde {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} vives. Y cuando escuches, perdona.

fr.L: Et écoute les supplications de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur et de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple Israël quand ils prieront vers ce lieu ; et {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, écoute depuis le lieu de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} demeure, depuis les cieux ; écoute et pardonne.
fr.B: Écoute les supplications de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur et de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple Israël quand ils prieront vers ce lieu. Écoute du ciel, le lieu de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} demeure ; écoute et pardonne.
fr.R: Écoute quand moi, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, et {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple Israël, nous {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} demandons de l’aide en priant vers ce lieu. Écoute du ciel, où {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} habites. Et quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} entends, pardonne.

sw.L: Na usikilize dua za mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} na za watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Israeli watakapoomba wakielekea mahali hapa; {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} usikie kutoka mahali pa makao {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, kutoka mbinguni; usikie na kusamehe.
sw.B: Sikiliza dua za mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} na za watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Israeli wanapoomba wakielekea mahali hapa. Usikie kutoka mbinguni, makao {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}; {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} ukisikia, usamehe.
sw.R: Unisikilize mimi mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, na watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Israeli tunapoomba msaada {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} tukielekea mahali hapa. Sikiliza kutoka mbinguni unakoishi. Nawe ukisikia, usamehe.

vi.L: Xin lắng nghe lời nài xin của đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và của dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Y-sơ-ra-ên khi họ cầu nguyện hướng về nơi này; xin chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nghe từ nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngự, từ trời; xin nghe và tha thứ.
vi.B: Xin lắng nghe lời nài xin của đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và của dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Y-sơ-ra-ên khi họ cầu nguyện hướng về nơi này. Xin nghe từ trời, là nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngự; và khi nghe, xin tha thứ.
vi.R: Khi con, là đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Y-sơ-ra-ên cầu nguyện hướng về nơi này mà xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giúp đỡ, xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lắng nghe. Xin nghe từ trời, là nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngự. Và khi nghe, xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tha thứ.

ko.L: 그리고 주님의 종과 주님의 백성 이스라엘이 이곳을 향하여 기도할 때 그들의 간구를 들어 주십시오. 그리고 주님께서는 주님께서 계시는 곳에서, 곧 하늘에서 들으시고, 들으시면 용서해 주십시오.
ko.B: 이 종과 주님의 백성 이스라엘이 이곳을 향하여 기도할 때 그 간구를 들어 주십시오. 주님께서 계시는 곳, 하늘에서 들으시고, 들으시면 용서해 주십시오.
ko.R: 주님의 종인 저와 주님의 백성 이스라엘이 이곳을 향하여 기도하며 도움을 구할 때 들어 주십시오. 주님께서 계시는 하늘에서 들어 주십시오. 그리고 들으시면 용서해 주십시오.

decisions.choice: from the place of your dwelling, from the heavens: 1 Kings 8:30 has "to"
decisions.reason: Kings says "hear to the place of your dwelling, to the heavens", and "plea" in the singular. Chronicles says "from" and "pleas". Otherwise the verse is the same.

decisions.choice: hear from heaven: the refrain of the prayer
decisions.reason: The refrain of the prayer comes back in verses 21, 23, 25, 27, 30, 33, 35 and 39. In 1 Kings 8 it is "hear [in] the heavens"; Chronicles nearly always says "hear from the heavens". The house is the place toward which prayer is made; heaven is where Yahweh dwells and from where he answers.

decisions.choice: forgive: pardon and restore
decisions.reason: In the Bible this verb always has God as its subject. Forgiveness is the main thing Solomon asks for in the cases that follow.

decisions.choice: hear from heaven, your dwelling place, and forgive
decisions.reason: The refrain keeps one wording at each level, as in 1 Kings 8: Literal "hear from the heavens, the place of your dwelling", Balanced "hear from heaven, your dwelling place", Readable "listen from heaven, where you live".

decisions.choice: your servant (all levels); I (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 19.

decisions.choice: "escucha desde los cielos" (L); "escucha desde el cielo" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The refrain of the prayer keeps one wording at each level (meaning decision); Chronicles says "from the heavens" where 1 Kings 8:30 says "to", so Spanish says "desde".

decisions.choice: écoute depuis le lieu de ta demeure, depuis les cieux (L); écoute du ciel, le lieu de ta demeure (B); écoute du ciel, où tu habites (R)
decisions.reason: The refrain of the prayer keeps one wording per level each time it returns (verses 21-39), as French Kings does; Literal says "depuis" because Chronicles has "from" where Kings has "to" (m1).

decisions.choice: usikie kutoka mbinguni, mahali pa makao yako (Literal); usikie kutoka mbinguni, makao yako (Balanced); sikiliza kutoka mbinguni unakoishi (Readable)
decisions.reason: The refrain keeps one wording at each level through the prayer. Where 1 Kings 8 has no "from" the Swahili Kings says "[huko] mbinguni" or "ukiwa mbinguni"; Chronicles says "from", so this block says "kutoka mbinguni", except in verse 27, where the Hebrew again has no "from".

decisions.choice: "xin nghe từ trời" as the refrain of the prayer
decisions.reason: Chronicles says "from" where Kings has "to" the place of your dwelling (m1), so Literal has no brackets here; the refrain keeps one wording at each level through the prayer, as in 1 Kings 8.

decisions.choice: The refrain "하늘에서 들으시고 ... 용서해 주십시오" kept the same through the prayer
decisions.reason: "Hear from heaven" is the prayer's refrain (m2); one wording per level, as in 1 Kings 8.

source.text: אִם־יֶחֱטָ֥א אִישׁ֙ לְרֵעֵ֔הוּ וְנָֽשָׁא־ב֥וֹ אָלָ֖ה לְהַֽאֲלֹת֑וֹ וּבָ֗א אָלָ֛ה לִפְנֵ֥י מִֽזְבַּחֲךָ֖ בַּבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: If sins a man against his neighbor, and he lays on him an oath to make him swear, and comes [the] oath before your altar in the house the this,

en.L: If a man sins against his neighbor, and he lays an oath on him to make him swear, and the oath comes before {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} altar in this house,
en.B: When someone sins against a neighbor and is required to take an oath, and comes and swears the oath before {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} altar in this house,
en.R: Suppose someone is accused of wronging a neighbor and is made to swear an oath that he is innocent. If he comes and takes this oath in front of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} altar in this temple,

es.L: Si alguno peca contra su prójimo, y le exigen juramento para hacerlo jurar, y viene el juramento delante de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} altar en esta casa,
es.B: Cuando alguien peque contra su prójimo y se le exija prestar juramento, y venga a jurar delante de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} altar en esta casa,
es.R: Supongamos que alguien es acusado de hacerle daño a su prójimo y se le obliga a jurar que es inocente. Si viene y hace ese juramento delante de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} altar en este templo,

fr.L: Si un homme pèche contre son prochain, et qu’on lui impose un serment pour le faire jurer, et que le serment vienne devant {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} autel dans cette maison,
fr.B: Quand quelqu’un aura péché contre son prochain et qu’on exigera de lui un serment, et qu’il viendra prêter serment devant {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} autel dans cette maison,
fr.R: Supposons que quelqu’un soit accusé d’avoir fait du tort à son prochain et qu’on l’oblige à jurer qu’il est innocent. S’il vient prêter ce serment devant {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} autel dans ce temple,

sw.L: Mtu akimkosea jirani yake, naye akamtwika kiapo ili amwapishe, na kiapo kikaja mbele ya madhabahu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} katika nyumba hii,
sw.B: Mtu akimkosea jirani yake na kutakiwa kuapa, naye akaja na kuapa kiapo mbele ya madhabahu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} katika nyumba hii,
sw.R: Tuseme mtu ameshtakiwa kwamba amemkosea jirani yake, naye analazimishwa kuapa kwamba hana hatia. Akija na kuapa kiapo hicho mbele ya madhabahu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} katika hekalu hili,

vi.L: Nếu một người phạm tội với người lân cận mình, và người ta bắt người ấy phải thề, và lời thề ấy đến trước bàn thờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong nhà này,
vi.B: Khi có người phạm tội với người lân cận và bị buộc phải thề, rồi người ấy đến thề trước bàn thờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong nhà này,
vi.R: Giả sử có người bị cáo buộc làm hại người lân cận và bị buộc phải thề rằng mình vô tội. Nếu người ấy đến thề trước bàn thờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong đền thờ này,

ko.L: 어떤 사람이 자기 이웃에게 죄를 지어, 그에게 맹세를 지워 맹세하게 하고, 그 맹세가 이 집에 있는 주님의 제단 앞에 오면,
ko.B: 누가 이웃에게 죄를 지었다는 일로 맹세를 해야 하게 되어, 이 집에 있는 주님의 제단 앞에 와서 맹세하면,
ko.R: 어떤 사람이 이웃에게 잘못했다는 고발을 당해서, 자기는 죄가 없다고 맹세해야 한다고 합시다. 그가 이 성전에 있는 주님의 제단 앞에 와서 맹세하면,

decisions.choice: If: 1 Kings 8:31 has a different opening word
decisions.reason: Kings opens with a word meaning "in the case that", Chronicles with "if". The meaning is the same, and the wording is the same.

decisions.choice: an oath to make him swear: an oath calling down a curse on himself if he is guilty
decisions.reason: When a wrong could not be proved by witnesses, the accused person swore before Yahweh that he was innocent, accepting a curse if he lied (Exodus 22:6-10; Numbers 5:19-22). Yahweh himself was then left to judge.

decisions.choice: he lays an oath on him: the one wronged, or the judges, require the oath
decisions.reason: The Hebrew does not name who lays the oath on the accused. It is probably the neighbor who brings the charge, or the judges who hear the case.

decisions.choice: accused of; that he is innocent (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable explains the situation: the wrong has not been proved, and the oath is a claim of innocence that only God can test.

decisions.choice: Readable opens each case with "...고 합시다"
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 8:31-50: the long conditions are split into short sentences.

source.text: וְאַתָּ֣ה׀תִּשְׁמַ֣ע מִן־הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם וְעָשִׂ֨יתָ֙ וְשָׁפַטְתָּ֣ אֶת־עֲבָדֶ֔יךָ לְהָשִׁ֣יב לְרָשָׁ֔ע לָתֵ֥ת דַּרְכּ֖וֹ בְּרֹאשׁ֑וֹ וּלְהַצְדִּ֣יק צַדִּ֔יק לָ֥תֶת ל֖וֹ כְּצִדְקָתֽוֹ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: and you, hear from the heavens, and act, and judge your servants, to repay [the] guilty, to give his way on his head, and to justify [the] righteous, to give to him according to his righteousness.

en.L: then {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, hear from the heavens, and act, and judge {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} slaves, repaying the guilty by bringing his way on his own head, and justifying the righteous by giving to him according to his righteousness.
en.B: then hear from heaven and act. Judge between {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servants: repay the guilty by bringing on his own head what he has done, and declare the innocent in the right by rewarding him for his righteousness.
en.R: then listen from heaven and act. Judge between {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servants. Punish the guilty one for what he has done, and show that the innocent one is right by rewarding him for his righteousness.

es.L: entonces {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} escucha desde los cielos, y actúa, y juzga a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} siervos, dando su pago al culpable, haciendo recaer su camino sobre su cabeza, y justificando al justo, dándole conforme a su justicia.
es.B: escucha entonces desde el cielo y actúa. Juzga entre {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} siervos: dale su pago al culpable haciendo caer sobre su cabeza lo que hizo, y declara inocente al justo dándole lo que merece por su justicia.
es.R: entonces escucha desde el cielo y actúa. Juzga entre {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} siervos. Castiga al culpable por lo que hizo, y muestra que el inocente tiene razón, premiándolo por su justicia.

fr.L: alors {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, écoute depuis les cieux, et agis, et juge {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} esclaves, en rendant au coupable pour faire retomber sa conduite sur sa tête, et en justifiant le juste pour lui rendre selon sa justice.
fr.B: alors écoute du ciel et agis. Juge entre {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} serviteurs : rends au coupable en faisant retomber sur sa tête ce qu’il a fait, et déclare juste l’innocent en le récompensant selon sa justice.
fr.R: alors écoute du ciel et agis. Juge entre {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} serviteurs. Punis le coupable pour ce qu’il a fait, et montre que l’innocent a raison en le récompensant pour sa droiture.

sw.L: basi {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} usikie kutoka mbinguni, ukatende, ukawahukumu watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, ukimlipa mwenye hatia kwa kuirudisha njia yake juu ya kichwa chake, na kumhesabia haki mwenye haki kwa kumpa kwa kadiri ya haki yake.
sw.B: basi usikie kutoka mbinguni, ukatende. Uwahukumu watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}: umlipe mwenye hatia kwa kuleta juu ya kichwa chake yale aliyoyatenda, na umtangaze asiye na hatia kuwa yuko sawa kwa kumlipa kwa kadiri ya haki yake.
sw.R: basi sikiliza kutoka mbinguni, ukatende. Uwahukumu watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}. Umwadhibu mwenye hatia kwa yale aliyoyatenda, na umwonyeshe asiye na hatia kuwa yuko sawa kwa kumlipa kwa haki yake.

vi.L: thì xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nghe từ trời, hành động và xét xử các đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: báo trả kẻ có tội bằng cách đổ đường lối nó lại trên đầu nó, và tuyên bố người công chính là vô tội bằng cách ban cho người theo sự công chính của người.
vi.B: thì xin nghe từ trời và hành động. Xin xét xử giữa các đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: báo trả kẻ có tội bằng cách đổ lại trên đầu nó những gì nó đã làm, và xử người vô tội là đúng bằng cách ban thưởng cho người theo sự công chính của người.
vi.R: thì xin nghe từ trời và hành động. Xin xét xử giữa các đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Xin phạt kẻ có tội vì điều nó đã làm, và cho thấy người vô tội là đúng bằng cách ban thưởng cho người vì sự công chính của người.

ko.L: 주님께서는 하늘에서 들으시고 행하셔서 주님의 종들을 재판하시되, 악한 사람에게 갚아 그의 행위를 그의 머리에 돌리시고, 의로운 사람은 의롭다 하여 그의 의로움대로 갚아 주십시오.
ko.B: 주님께서는 하늘에서 들으시고 행하셔서 주님의 종들 사이를 재판해 주십시오. 죄 있는 사람에게는 그가 한 대로 그 머리에 갚으시고, 죄 없는 사람은 옳다고 인정하여 그의 의로움대로 갚아 주십시오.
ko.R: 주님께서는 하늘에서 들으시고 행동해 주십시오. 주님의 종들 사이를 재판해 주십시오. 죄 있는 사람은 그가 한 대로 벌을 주시고, 죄 없는 사람은 그가 옳다는 것을 보여 주시고 그의 의로움대로 갚아 주십시오.

decisions.choice: from the heavens; to repay the guilty: 1 Kings 8:32 differs
decisions.reason: Kings says "hear [in] the heavens" and "condemn the guilty". Chronicles says "from the heavens" and "repay the guilty". Both ask Yahweh to give the guilty what his deeds deserve.

decisions.choice: justify the righteous: declare the innocent in the right
decisions.reason: These are words of the law court. A judge was to declare the innocent in the right and the guilty in the wrong (Deuteronomy 25:1). Solomon asks Yahweh to do this where human judges cannot know the truth.

decisions.choice: bringing his way on his head: making his own conduct fall back on him
decisions.reason: The guilty person bears the results of what he has done (1 Kings 2:32-33).

decisions.choice: hear from heaven
decisions.reason: As in verse 21: the refrain keeps one wording at each level.

decisions.choice: slaves (Literal); servants (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 14.

decisions.choice: "dando su pago al culpable" (L); "dale su pago" (B)
decisions.reason: Chronicles says "repay the guilty" where 1 Kings 8:32 says "condemn" (meaning decision); Spanish follows the change.

If they then turn back to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, honor {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, and pray to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} in this temple, asking for mercy,

es.L: Y si {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo Israel es derrotado delante del enemigo por haber pecado contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, y se vuelven y confiesan {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre y oran y suplican delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} en esta casa,
es.B: Si {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo Israel es derrotado por un enemigo por haber pecado contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, y se vuelven, reconocen {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre, y oran y te suplican en esta casa,

fr.L: Et si {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple Israël est battu devant un ennemi parce qu’ils ont péché contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, et qu’ils reviennent, et confessent {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, et prient et supplient devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} dans cette maison,

fr.R: Supposons que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple Israël soit battu par un ennemi parce qu’il a péché contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. S’ils reviennent ensuite vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, s’ils honorent {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom et s’ils {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} prient dans ce temple en demandant {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} pitié,

sw.R: Tuseme watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} Israeli wameshindwa na adui kwa sababu wamekutenda dhambi. Kama watakurudia, wakaliheshimu jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, wakakuomba katika hekalu hili wakiomba rehema,

vi.L: Nếu dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Y-sơ-ra-ên bị đánh bại trước kẻ thù vì họ đã phạm tội với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, rồi họ quay về, xưng nhận danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, cầu nguyện và nài xin trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong nhà này,
vi.B: Nếu dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Y-sơ-ra-ên bị kẻ thù đánh bại vì đã phạm tội với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, rồi họ quay về, tôn xưng danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, cầu nguyện và nài xin trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong nhà này,
vi.R: Giả sử dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Y-sơ-ra-ên bị kẻ thù đánh bại vì họ đã phạm tội với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Nếu sau đó họ quay về với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, tôn vinh danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và cầu nguyện xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thương xót trong đền thờ này,

ko.B: 주님의 백성 이스라엘이 주님께 죄를 지어 원수에게 패했다가, 돌아와 주님의 이름을 인정하고 이 집에서 주님 앞에 기도하며 간구하면,
ko.R: 주님의 백성 이스라엘이 주님께 죄를 지어서 원수에게 졌다고 합시다. 그들이 주님께로 돌아와 주님의 이름을 높이고, 이 성전에서 주님께 기도하며 자비를 구하면,

decisions.choice: small differences from 1 Kings 8:33
decisions.reason: Kings says "when" for "if", "turn back to you" and "plead with you". Chronicles says "if", "turn back" without "to you", and "plead before you". The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: defeat because of sin
decisions.reason: The covenant warned that if Israel turned from Yahweh they would be struck down before their enemies (Leviticus 26:17; Deuteronomy 28:25). Solomon asks for mercy when that happens.

decisions.choice: turn back: repent
decisions.reason: The verb "turn" or "return" is the main word for repentance in the Old Testament (Deuteronomy 30:2).

decisions.choice: confess your name: acknowledge Yahweh, praising him and admitting that he is just
decisions.reason: The verb means to acknowledge, give thanks or confess. Turning back to Yahweh includes owning that he was right to punish (Joshua 7:19).

decisions.choice: confess (Literal); acknowledge (Balanced); honor (Readable)
decisions.reason: Each level keeps one word for this verb through the prayer (verses 24 and 26), as in 1 Kings 8. Readable says "turn back to you", since the turning is toward Yahweh.

decisions.choice: "confiesan" (L); "reconocen" (B); "honran" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English (r-en-1) and the Spanish of 1 Kings 8:33: confessing the name is acknowledging God, and each level keeps its verb through the prayer.

decisions.choice: "xưng nhận" (L); "tôn xưng" (B); "tôn vinh" (R)
decisions.reason: One word at each level for confessing the name through the prayer (verses 24 and 26), as 1 Kings 8:33, 35.

fr.R: alors écoute du ciel et pardonne le péché de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple Israël. Ramène-les dans le pays que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} leur as donné, à eux et à leurs ancêtres.

ko.B: 주님께서는 하늘에서 들으시고 주님의 백성 이스라엘의 죄를 용서해 주십시오. 그리고 그들과 그들의 조상들에게 주신 땅으로 그들을 다시 데려와 주십시오.
ko.R: 주님께서는 하늘에서 들으시고 주님의 백성 이스라엘의 죄를 용서해 주십시오. 그들을 그들과 그들의 조상들에게 주신 땅으로 다시 데려와 주십시오.

decisions.choice: from the heavens; to them and to their fathers: 1 Kings 8:34 differs
decisions.reason: Kings says "hear [in] the heavens" and "the land that you gave to their fathers". Chronicles says "from the heavens" and "to them and to their fathers": the land was given to each generation, not only to the first.

decisions.choice: bring them back to the land: those taken captive after the defeat
decisions.reason: Defeat in battle often meant that some were carried off as prisoners (Deuteronomy 28:41). Solomon asks that they be brought home.

decisions.choice: hear from heaven and forgive
decisions.reason: As in verse 21: the refrain keeps one wording at each level.

decisions.choice: fathers (Literal); ancestors (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The word means forefathers, the generations before them.

decisions.choice: "tổ phụ" (L); "tổ tiên" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 8:34 and the death formula of the terms note.

records.literal_gloss: When are shut up [the] heavens and there is no rain, because they sin against you, and they pray toward the place the this and confess your name, from their sin they turn back, because you afflict them,

en.L: When the heavens are shut up and there is no rain because they have sinned against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, and they pray toward this place and confess {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name and turn back from their sin because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} afflict them,
en.B: When the sky is shut and there is no rain because they have sinned against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, and they pray toward this place, acknowledge {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, and turn from their sin because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have humbled them,
en.R: Suppose the sky is closed and no rain falls because the people have sinned against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. If they pray toward this place, honor {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, and turn away from their sin because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have punished them,

es.L: Cuando los cielos se cierren y no haya lluvia, por haber pecado contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, y oren hacia este lugar y confiesen {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre y se vuelvan de su pecado, porque los afliges,

es.R: Supongamos que el cielo se cierra y no llueve porque el pueblo ha pecado contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. Si oran hacia este lugar, honran {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre y se apartan de su pecado porque los has castigado,

fr.L: Quand les cieux seront fermés et qu’il n’y aura pas de pluie parce qu’ils auront péché contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, et qu’ils prieront vers ce lieu, et confesseront {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, et se détourneront de leur péché parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} les affliges,

decisions.choice: the heavens shut up: drought sent as a warning
decisions.reason: The covenant warned that Yahweh would shut up the heavens so that there would be no rain if Israel turned to other gods (Deuteronomy 11:17; Leviticus 26:19). Yahweh answers this request in 7:13-14.

decisions.choice: because you afflict them
decisions.reason: The Hebrew vowels give "because you afflict them": the drought has humbled them and made them turn. The same letters can be read "when you answer them", meaning that they turn from sin when Yahweh answers their prayer. The traditional reading is followed, as in 1 Kings 8:35.

decisions.choice: the people (Readable)

decisions.choice: hear the heavens: here, as in 1 Kings 8:36, without "from"
decisions.reason: This is the one place in the refrain where Chronicles, like Kings, has no word for "from": "hear [in] the heavens". The verse is the same as 1 Kings 8:36, and the wording is the same.

decisions.choice: when you teach them: forgiveness goes with Yahweh's teaching
decisions.reason: The little word can mean "when", "for" or "so that". Yahweh forgives as he teaches his people, through the hardship and through his word, the way they should live. The verb "teach" is related to the word *torah*, "instruction".

decisions.choice: your land ... as an inheritance: Yahweh's land given to Israel
decisions.reason: The land belongs to Yahweh (Leviticus 25:23), and he gave it to Israel as a family inheritance. So the rain on it is his gift too (Deuteronomy 11:11-14).

decisions.choice: hear [in] the heavens (Literal); hear in heaven (Balanced); slaves, servants
decisions.reason: Where the Hebrew has no "from", Literal and Balanced keep the wording of 1 Kings 8:36; Readable keeps its refrain. "Slaves" at Literal and "servants" at the other levels, as in verse 14; Balanced and Readable take "your servants and your people Israel" as two names for the same people.

decisions.choice: "escucha [en] los cielos" (L); "escucha en el cielo" (B)
decisions.reason: Here alone the refrain has no word for "from", as in 1 Kings 8:36 (meaning decision); Spanish keeps "en" at Literal and Balanced, as the English does.

decisions.choice: écoute [dans] les cieux (L); écoute dans le ciel (B)
decisions.reason: Here Chronicles, like Kings, has no word for "from" (m1), so Literal keeps the bracket of French Kings and Balanced says "dans le ciel", as the English Balanced says "in heaven"; Readable keeps its refrain.

decisions.choice: "nghe [trên] trời" (L), "nghe trên trời" (B), without "từ"
decisions.reason: Here the Hebrew has no "from" (m1), as 1 Kings 8:36; Literal and Balanced show it, Readable keeps its refrain.

records.literal_gloss: Famine, if there is in the land, pestilence, if there is, blight and mildew, locust and grasshopper, if there is; if besiege it its enemies in [the] land of its gates; any plague and any sickness,

en.L: If there is famine in the land, if there is pestilence, blight and mildew, locust and grasshopper, if their enemies besiege them in the land of their gates, whatever plague and whatever sickness [there is],
en.B: If there is famine in the land, or disease, or blight or mildew, locusts or grasshoppers, or if their enemies besiege them in any of their cities, whatever plague or sickness there is,
en.R: Suppose there is a famine in the land, or a deadly disease, or the crops are ruined by hot winds or mildew, or locusts and grasshoppers eat them. Or suppose enemies surround one of their towns and attack it, or any other disaster or sickness comes.

es.L: Si hay hambre en la tierra, si hay peste, tizón y añublo, langosta y saltamontes, si sus enemigos los sitian en la tierra de sus puertas, cualquier plaga y cualquier enfermedad,
es.B: Si hay hambre en el país, o peste, o tizón o añublo, langostas o saltamontes, o si sus enemigos los sitian en alguna de sus ciudades, cualquiera que sea la plaga o la enfermedad,
es.R: Supongamos que hay hambre en el país, o una enfermedad mortal, o que las cosechas se arruinan por vientos calientes o por moho, o que las langostas y los saltamontes se las comen. O supongamos que unos enemigos rodean una de sus ciudades y la atacan, o que viene cualquier otro desastre o enfermedad.

fr.L: S’il y a dans le pays la famine, s’il y a la peste, la rouille et la nielle, la sauterelle et le criquet, si leurs ennemis les assiègent dans le pays de leurs portes, quelque fléau, quelque maladie [qu’il y ait],
fr.B: S’il y a dans le pays la famine ou la peste, la rouille ou la nielle, les sauterelles ou les criquets, ou si leurs ennemis les assiègent dans l’une de leurs villes, quel que soit le fléau ou la maladie,
fr.R: Supposons qu’il y ait une famine dans le pays, ou une maladie mortelle, ou que les récoltes soient détruites par des vents brûlants ou par la nielle, ou que les sauterelles et les criquets les dévorent. Ou supposons que des ennemis encerclent une de leurs villes et l’attaquent, ou qu’un autre malheur ou une autre maladie arrive.

decisions.choice: small differences from 1 Kings 8:37
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "and" between the pairs, and "its enemies" in the plural where Kings has "its enemy". The words "in the land of its gates" are the same in both.

decisions.choice: blight, mildew: diseases of the grain
decisions.reason: The first word is the scorching of crops by the hot east wind; the second is a disease that turns grain pale or yellow. They appear together among the covenant curses (Deuteronomy 28:22; Amos 4:9).

decisions.choice: locust, grasshopper: two kinds or stages of locust
decisions.reason: Several Hebrew words name locusts. The second comes from a verb meaning "consume" and may be a stage of the locust's growth, or another insect that strips the fields.

decisions.choice: in the land of their gates: in their cities
decisions.reason: "Gates" stands for cities, as often (Deuteronomy 12:15). The sense is that an enemy besieges one of Israel's towns. The Hebrew speaks of the nation as "it", one body.

decisions.choice: crops are ruined by hot winds (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable describes the blight by its cause, as in 1 Kings 8:37.

fr.B: toute prière, toute supplication faite par quiconque ou par tout {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple Israël, chacun connaissant sa détresse et sa douleur et tendant les mains vers cette maison,

vi.L: thì bất cứ lời cầu nguyện, bất cứ lời nài xin nào của bất cứ người nào hay của cả dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Y-sơ-ra-ên, mỗi người biết tai họa của mình và nỗi đau của mình, và giơ tay hướng về nhà này,
vi.B: thì bất cứ lời cầu nguyện hay lời nài xin thương xót nào của bất cứ ai, hay của cả dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Y-sơ-ra-ên, mỗi người biết tai họa và nỗi đau của chính mình và giơ tay hướng về nhà này,
vi.R: Nếu có ai trong dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Y-sơ-ra-ên, hay cả dân cùng nhau, cảm thấy nỗi đau khổ và buồn rầu của mình, cầu nguyện với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, giơ tay hướng về đền thờ này mà xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giúp đỡ,

ko.L: 어떤 사람이든, 주님의 백성 이스라엘 모두든지, 각자 자기 재앙과 자기 고통을 알고 이 집을 향하여 두 손바닥을 펴서 어떤 기도나 어떤 간구를 드리면,
ko.B: 어떤 사람이든 주님의 백성 이스라엘 전체든, 저마다 자기가 당한 재앙과 고통을 깨닫고 이 집을 향하여 두 손을 펴 들고 기도하며 간구하면,
ko.R: 주님의 백성 이스라엘 가운데 누구라도, 또는 온 백성이 함께, 자기가 겪는 재앙과 슬픔 때문에 마음이 아파서, 이 성전을 향해 두 손을 펴 들고 주님께 기도하며 도움을 구하면,

decisions.choice: his plague and his pain: 1 Kings 8:38 has "the plague of his heart"
decisions.reason: Kings speaks of each one knowing "the plague of his own heart". Chronicles names two things: "his plague and his pain". Both mean the trouble each person feels for himself. Otherwise the verse is the same.

decisions.choice: plague, pain: the disaster and the grief it brings
decisions.reason: The word "plague" picks up the list of verse 28; "pain" is the sorrow and suffering it causes. Each one knows their own trouble and brings it to God.

decisions.choice: by any person or by all your people: one person or the whole nation
decisions.reason: Solomon asks Yahweh to hear both the prayer of one person and the prayer of all Israel together.

decisions.choice: spreading out his palms: praying
decisions.reason: As in verse 12.

decisions.choice: their (inclusive); his (traditional)
decisions.reason: "Each" means every person, man or woman, so the pronoun is inclusive by default.

decisions.choice: "cada uno ... su", with no gender span
decisions.reason: As the Spanish of 1 Kings 8:38: Spanish "su" serves for "their" and "his" alike, and "cada uno" already reads as every person, so there is no second wording.

decisions.choice: no gender span: "chacun ... sa plaie ... ses paumes"
decisions.reason: French possessives agree with the thing possessed, not with the person, so "sa plaie", "ses paumes" already cover men and women; the English needs a span for "their" and "his", French does not.

decisions.choice: lake, yake (no gender span)
decisions.reason: Swahili "-ake" means his or her, so "kila mmoja ... mikono yake" already includes every person and the gender setting has nothing to change.

decisions.choice: no gender span: "mỗi người ... của mình"
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "mỗi người" and the reflexive "mình" already cover men and women, so the English gender span has no counterpart.

decisions.choice: No gender span: "각자", "저마다", "누구라도" cover men and women
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 8:38; Korean needs no pronoun here, so the English gender setting has no counterpart.

records.literal_gloss: and you, hear from the heavens, [the] place of your dwelling, and forgive, and give to each according to all his ways, whose heart you know, for you, you alone, know [the] heart of [the] children of the humankind,

en.L: then {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, hear from the heavens, the place of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} dwelling, and forgive, and give to each one according to all {{gender:their|his}} ways, whose heart {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} know, for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} alone, know the heart of the {{gender:children|sons}} of {{gender:humankind|man}},
en.B: then hear from heaven, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} dwelling place, and forgive. Give to each one according to all {{gender:their|his}} ways, for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} know each heart. You alone know the human heart,
en.R: then listen from heaven, where {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} live, and forgive. Deal with each person according to everything {{gender:they have|he has}} done, because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} know what is in every heart. You are the only one who knows what is in people's hearts.

es.L: entonces {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} escucha desde los cielos, el lugar de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} morada, y perdona, y da a cada uno conforme a todos sus caminos, cuyo corazón {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} conoces, porque solo {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} conoces el corazón de {{gender:los seres humanos|los hijos de los hombres}},
es.B: escucha entonces desde el cielo, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} morada, y perdona. Da a cada uno conforme a todos sus caminos, pues {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} conoces cada corazón. Solo {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} conoces el corazón del ser humano,
es.R: entonces escucha desde el cielo, donde {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} vives, y perdona. Trata a cada persona según todo lo que ha hecho, porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} sabes lo que hay en cada corazón. Tú eres el único que sabe lo que hay en el corazón de las personas.

fr.L: alors {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, écoute depuis les cieux, le lieu de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} demeure, et pardonne, et rends à chacun selon toutes ses voies, {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui connais son cœur, car {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} seul, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} connais le cœur des {{gender:êtres humains|fils de l’homme}},
fr.B: alors écoute du ciel, le lieu de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} demeure, et pardonne. Rends à chacun selon toute sa conduite, car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} connais chaque cœur. Toi seul, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} connais le cœur des {{gender:humains|hommes}},
fr.R: alors écoute du ciel, où {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} habites, et pardonne. Traite chacun selon tout ce qu’il a fait, parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} sais ce qu’il y a dans chaque cœur. Tu es le seul à savoir ce qu’il y a dans le cœur des {{gender:êtres humains|hommes}}.

sw.B: basi usikie kutoka mbinguni, makao {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, usamehe. Umpe kila mmoja kwa kadiri ya njia zake zote, kwa kuwa unaujua kila moyo. Wewe peke {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} unaijua mioyo ya wanadamu,
sw.R: basi sikiliza kutoka mbinguni unakoishi, usamehe. Umtendee kila mtu kwa kadiri ya yote aliyoyafanya, kwa sababu unajua yaliyo katika kila moyo. Wewe peke {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ndiye ujuaye yaliyo mioyoni mwa watu.

vi.R: thì xin nghe từ trời, nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngự, và tha thứ. Xin đối xử với mỗi người theo mọi việc họ đã làm, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} biết điều có trong mỗi tấm lòng. Chỉ một mình {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} biết điều có trong lòng mọi người.

ko.L: 주님께서는 주님께서 계시는 곳, 곧 하늘에서 들으시고 용서하시고, 그 마음을 주님께서 아시는 각 사람에게 그의 모든 행위대로 갚아 주십시오. 주님만, 오직 주님만이 사람의 자녀의 마음을 아시기 때문입니다.

ko.R: 주님께서는 주님께서 계시는 하늘에서 들으시고 용서해 주십시오. 그리고 각 사람이 한 모든 일대로 갚아 주십시오. 주님께서는 모든 사람의 마음속을 아십니다. 사람의 마음을 아시는 분은 주님 한 분뿐이십니다.

decisions.choice: from the heavens; no "and act": 1 Kings 8:39 differs
decisions.reason: Kings says "hear [in] the heavens", "forgive and act", and "the heart of all the children of humankind". Chronicles says "from the heavens", has only "forgive" before "give", and has no "all" before "children". The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: you alone know the heart of all people
decisions.reason: Only Yahweh sees what is in the heart (1 Samuel 16:7; 1 Chronicles 28:9; Jeremiah 17:10). So only he can forgive and judge rightly.

decisions.choice: the place of your dwelling: heaven, Yahweh's fixed dwelling
decisions.reason: The word for "place" is the one used in verse 2 for the house as "a place for your dwelling". Now Solomon gives the same name to heaven: the house is where prayer is directed, heaven is where Yahweh truly dwells. Verses 33 and 39 use the same words.

decisions.choice: hear from heaven and forgive
decisions.reason: As in verse 21: the refrain keeps one wording at each level.

decisions.choice: their; children of humankind (inclusive); his; sons of man (traditional)
decisions.reason: Solomon speaks of every human being, so the inclusive form is the default.

decisions.choice: {{gender:los seres humanos|los hijos de los hombres}} (L)
decisions.reason: As the English (r-en-1) and the Spanish of 1 Kings 8:39: Literal offers an inclusive wording for "the children of humankind" with the traditional one as the alternative; "cada uno", "su" need no span.

decisions.choice: "사람의 자녀" (L), "사람" (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: Korean "사람" and "자녀" are inclusive, so one wording serves both English settings.

records.literal_gloss: so that they fear you, to walk in your ways all the days that they [are] living on [the] face of the land that you gave to our fathers.

en.L: so that they may fear {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, to walk in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} ways, all the days that they live on the face of the land that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} gave to our fathers.
en.B: so that they will fear {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} and walk in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} ways for as long as they live in the land {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} gave to our ancestors.
en.R: Then they will respect and obey {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} and follow {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} ways as long as they live in the land {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} gave our ancestors.

es.L: para que te teman, para andar en {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} caminos, todos los días que vivan sobre la faz de la tierra que diste a nuestros padres.
es.B: para que te teman y anden en {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} caminos todos los días que vivan en la tierra que diste a nuestros antepasados.
es.R: Así te respetarán y te obedecerán, y seguirán {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} caminos mientras vivan en la tierra que les diste a nuestros antepasados.

fr.L: afin qu’ils {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} craignent, pour marcher dans {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} voies, tous les jours qu’ils vivront sur la face du pays que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as donné à nos pères.

fr.R: Alors ils {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} respecteront, ils {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}obéiront et ils suivront {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} chemins tant qu’ils vivront dans le pays que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as donné à nos ancêtres.

sw.L: ili wakuche, kwenda katika njia {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, siku zote watakazoishi juu ya uso wa nchi uliyowapa baba zetu.
sw.B: ili wakuche na kuenenda katika njia {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} siku zote watakazoishi katika nchi uliyowapa babu zetu.

vi.L: để họ kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, bước đi trong các đường lối {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, trọn những ngày họ sống trên mặt đất mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban cho tổ phụ chúng con.
vi.B: để họ kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và bước đi trong các đường lối {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} suốt những ngày họ sống trong xứ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban cho tổ tiên chúng con.
vi.R: Như vậy họ sẽ tôn kính và vâng phục {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và sống theo đường lối {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} suốt đời họ sống trong xứ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban cho tổ tiên chúng con.

ko.L: 그리하여 그들이 주님께서 우리 조상들에게 주신 땅 위에서 사는 모든 날 동안 주님을 경외하고 주님의 길로 걷게 해 주십시오.
ko.B: 그러면 그들이 주님께서 우리 조상들에게 주신 땅에서 사는 동안 늘 주님을 경외하고 주님의 길로 걸을 것입니다.
ko.R: 그러면 그들이 주님께서 우리 조상들에게 주신 땅에서 사는 동안 언제나 주님을 두려워하며 따르고, 주님께서 가르치신 길로 살 것입니다.

decisions.choice: to walk in your ways: not in 1 Kings 8:40
decisions.reason: Chronicles adds "to walk in your ways": the fear of Yahweh shows itself in obedience. Otherwise the verse is the same as 1 Kings 8:40, and the wording is the same.

decisions.choice: fear you: hold Yahweh in reverent awe and obey him
decisions.reason: To fear Yahweh is to honor him so deeply that one lives by his commands (Deuteronomy 6:2; 10:12). His forgiveness leads to this fear (Psalm 130:4).

decisions.choice: respect and obey (Readable); fathers (Literal), ancestors (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable avoids "fear", which could suggest terror, and says what the fear of God leads to, as in 1 Kings 8:40.

decisions.choice: "tôn kính và vâng phục" (R) for "fear"
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 8:40: Readable says what the fear of God leads to, so that it is not read as terror.

records.literal_gloss: And also to the foreigner who not of your people Israel [is] he, and comes from a land distant for the sake of your name the great and your hand the strong and your arm the outstretched, and they come and pray toward the house the this,

en.L: And also to the foreigner who [is] not of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people Israel, but comes from a distant land for the sake of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} great name and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} strong hand and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} outstretched arm, and they come and pray toward this house,
en.B: As for the foreigner who is not one of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people Israel but comes from a distant land because of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} great name, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} mighty hand and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} outstretched arm, when they come and pray facing this house,
en.R: A foreigner who does not belong to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people Israel may come from a distant land because of how great {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are and the mighty things {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} strong hand and powerful arm. decisions.choice: one verse for 1 Kings 8:41-42
decisions.reason: Kings says the foreigner comes "for the sake of your name", then explains: "for they will hear of your great name and your strong hand and your outstretched arm". Chronicles joins it all in one phrase: he comes "for the sake of your great name and your strong hand and your outstretched arm".

decisions.choice: the foreigner: a person from another nation
decisions.reason: This word means someone who belongs to another people, not the outsider who lives among Israel. Solomon prays for those who come from far away.

decisions.choice: strong hand and outstretched arm: Yahweh's power shown in the exodus
decisions.reason: The pair is used of Yahweh's acts in bringing Israel out of Egypt (Deuteronomy 4:34; 5:15). The nations hear of these acts, as Rahab had (Joshua 2:10).

decisions.choice: they come and pray: the one foreigner stands for many
decisions.reason: The verbs change from singular to plural: Solomon has in mind all the foreigners who will come.

decisions.choice: how great you are; foreigners (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable explains "your great name" as Yahweh's greatness, and follows the plural verbs with "foreigners".

decisions.choice: "el extranjero"
decisions.reason: The foreigner from another nation is "extranjero" at every level, as in the Spanish of 1 Kings 8:41; the plural verbs that follow are kept, as the Hebrew has them (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: 1 Kings 8:41-42 in one verse
decisions.reason: Chronicles puts the two verses of Kings into one (m1); Vietnamese keeps their wording without the brackets of 1 Kings 8:42.

vi.L: Khi dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra trận đánh kẻ thù, theo bất cứ đường nào {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sai họ đi, và họ cầu nguyện với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hướng về thành này mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chọn và nhà con đã xây cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},
vi.B: Khi dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra trận đánh kẻ thù, bất cứ nơi nào {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sai họ đi, và họ cầu nguyện với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, hướng về thành {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chọn này và nhà con đã xây cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},
vi.R: Giả sử dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra trận đánh kẻ thù ở bất cứ nơi nào {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sai họ đi. Nếu họ cầu nguyện với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, hướng về thành {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chọn này và đền thờ con đã xây cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},

ko.B: 주님의 백성이 주님께서 보내시는 곳으로 원수와 싸우러 나갈 때에, 주님께서 택하신 이 성읍과 제가 주님의 이름을 위하여 지은 이 집을 향하여 주님께 기도하면,
ko.R: 주님의 백성이 주님께서 보내시는 곳으로 원수와 싸우러 나간다고 합시다. 그들이 주님께서 택하신 이 성읍과 제가 주님의 이름을 위하여 지은 이 성전을 향해 주님께 기도하면,

decisions.choice: to you; this city: 1 Kings 8:44 differs
decisions.reason: Kings says "they pray to Yahweh", naming him in the third person, and "the city"; Chronicles says "they pray to you" and "this city". Chronicles also has "its enemies" in the plural.

decisions.choice: by the way that you send them: a war Yahweh has sent them to fight
decisions.reason: Solomon speaks of battles Yahweh has commanded, not wars of Israel's own choosing.

decisions.choice: toward this city: facing Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Soldiers far away would turn toward Jerusalem and its house to pray (verse 20).

decisions.choice: in the direction of (Literal); facing (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "the way of the city", meaning toward it.

decisions.choice: "te oren"
decisions.reason: Chronicles says "they pray to you" where 1 Kings 8:44 names Yahweh in the third person (meaning decision); Spanish follows with the clitic "te", without a span.

decisions.choice: "với Ngài", "thành này" where 1 Kings 8:44 has "với CHÚA" and "thành"
decisions.reason: Chronicles' small differences from the parallel (m1); otherwise the Vietnamese of 1 Kings 8:44.
