ko.B: 주님께서는 하늘에서 그들의 기도와 간구를 들으시고 그들의 사정을 돌보아 주십시오.
ko.R: 주님께서는 하늘에서 그들의 기도와 간구를 들으시고 그들 편이 되어 주십시오.

decisions.choice: from the heavens: 1 Kings 8:45 has no "from"
decisions.reason: Otherwise the verse is the same as 1 Kings 8:45, and the wording is the same.

decisions.choice: do their justice: uphold their cause
decisions.reason: The word for justice means giving each one what is right. Here Solomon asks Yahweh to take his people's side and give them the victory their cause deserves (Psalm 9:5).

decisions.choice: hear from heaven
decisions.reason: As in verse 21: the refrain keeps one wording at each level.

decisions.choice: stand up for them (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what it means to uphold someone's cause.

source.text: כִּ֣י יֶחֶטְאוּ־לָ֗ךְ כִּ֣י אֵ֤ין אָדָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־יֶחֱטָ֔א וְאָנַפְתָּ֣ בָ֔ם וּנְתַתָּ֖ם לִפְנֵ֣י אוֹיֵ֑ב וְשָׁב֧וּם שׁוֹבֵיהֶ֛ם אֶל־אֶ֥רֶץ רְחוֹקָ֖ה א֥וֹ קְרוֹבָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: When they sin against you, for there is no human who does not sin, and you are angry with them and give them before an enemy, and take them captive their captors to a land far or near,

en.L: When they sin against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} (for there is no human who does not sin), and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are angry with them and give them over before an enemy, and their captors take them captive to a land far or near,
en.B: When they sin against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} (and there is no one who never sins), and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are angry with them and hand them over to an enemy, and their captors take them away as prisoners to a land far away or near,
en.R: Everyone sins. So suppose {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people sin against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} become angry with them and let an enemy defeat them. Suppose their captors take them away as prisoners to a land far away or near.

es.L: Cuando pequen contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} (porque no hay ser humano que no peque), y te enojes contra ellos y los entregues delante del enemigo, y sus captores los lleven cautivos a una tierra lejana o cercana,
es.B: Cuando pequen contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} (pues no hay nadie que no peque), y te enojes con ellos y los entregues a un enemigo, y sus captores los lleven prisioneros a una tierra lejana o cercana,
es.R: Todos pecan. Así que supongamos que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo peca contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, y te enojas con ellos y dejas que un enemigo los venza. Supongamos que sus captores se los llevan prisioneros a una tierra lejana o cercana.

fr.L: Quand ils pécheront contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} (car il n’y a pas d’homme qui ne pèche pas), et que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} seras irrité contre eux et les livreras devant un ennemi, et que leurs vainqueurs les emmèneront captifs dans un pays lointain ou proche,
fr.B: Quand ils pécheront contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} (et il n’y a personne qui ne pèche jamais), que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} seras irrité contre eux et les livreras à un ennemi, et que leurs vainqueurs les emmèneront prisonniers dans un pays lointain ou proche,
fr.R: Tout le monde pèche. Alors supposons que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple pèche contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} te mettes en colère contre eux et que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} laisses un ennemi les vaincre. Supposons que leurs vainqueurs les emmènent prisonniers dans un pays loin ou près.

sw.L: Watakapokutenda dhambi (kwa maana hakuna mwanadamu asiyetenda dhambi), {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} ukawakasirikia na kuwatia mikononi mwa adui, na watekaji wao wakawachukua mateka mpaka nchi ya mbali au ya karibu,
sw.B: Watakapokutenda dhambi (na hakuna mtu asiyetenda dhambi kamwe), {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} ukawakasirikia na kuwatia mikononi mwa adui, na watekaji wao wakawachukua mateka mpaka nchi iliyo mbali au karibu,
sw.R: Kila mtu hutenda dhambi. Basi tuseme watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wamekutenda dhambi, {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} ukawakasirikia na kuruhusu adui awashinde. Tuseme watekaji wao wamewachukua mateka mpaka nchi iliyo mbali au karibu.

vi.L: Khi họ phạm tội với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} (vì không có người nào không phạm tội), và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nổi giận với họ, phó họ cho kẻ thù, và những kẻ bắt họ dẫn họ làm tù binh đến một xứ xa hay gần,
vi.B: Khi họ phạm tội với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} (vì không ai là không phạm tội), và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nổi giận, phó họ vào tay kẻ thù, và những kẻ bắt họ dẫn họ làm tù binh đến một xứ xa hay gần,
vi.R: Ai cũng phạm tội. Vậy giả sử dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phạm tội với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nổi giận với họ và để kẻ thù đánh bại họ. Giả sử kẻ thù bắt họ làm tù binh, dẫn đến một xứ xa hay gần.

ko.L: 그들이 주님께 죄를 지어서(죄를 짓지 않는 사람은 없습니다), 주님께서 그들에게 노하셔서 그들을 원수 앞에 넘기시고, 그들을 사로잡은 자들이 그들을 먼 땅이나 가까운 땅으로 사로잡아 가면,
ko.B: 그들이 주님께 죄를 지어서(죄를 짓지 않는 사람은 하나도 없습니다), 주님께서 그들에게 노하셔서 그들을 원수에게 넘기시고, 원수가 그들을 포로로 잡아 멀든 가깝든 다른 땅으로 끌고 가면,
ko.R: 죄를 짓지 않는 사람은 아무도 없습니다. 주님의 백성이 주님께 죄를 지어서, 주님께서 그들에게 노하셔서 원수가 그들을 이기게 하신다고 합시다. 그리고 원수들이 그들을 포로로 잡아 멀든 가깝든 다른 땅으로 끌고 간다고 합시다.

decisions.choice: to a land far or near: 1 Kings 8:46 has "to the land of the enemy"
decisions.reason: Kings says "to the land of the enemy, far or near"; Chronicles says only "to a land far or near". Otherwise the verse is the same, and the wording is the same.

decisions.choice: there is no one who does not sin
decisions.reason: Solomon admits that sin is universal, his own people included (Ecclesiastes 7:20; Psalm 143:2). The prayer does not hope that Israel will never sin, but that Yahweh will forgive when they turn back.

decisions.choice: taken captive to a distant land: the exile the covenant warned of
decisions.reason: The law warned that unfaithful Israel would be scattered among the nations (Leviticus 26:33-39; Deuteronomy 28:36, 64). Chronicles ends with Judah carried off to Babylon and then allowed to return (36:20-23), so its first readers would hear their own story in these verses.

decisions.choice: Everyone sins (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable moves the remark in brackets to the front as a short sentence of its own, and names "your people" as the subject.

decisions.choice: "no hay ser humano que no peque" (L)
decisions.reason: The English Literal says "human"; Spanish Literal says "ser humano", the plain word for any person, where the Spanish of 1 Kings 8:46 said "hombre".

source.text: וְהֵשִׁ֨יבוּ֙ אֶל־לְבָבָ֔ם בָּאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִשְׁבּוּ־שָׁ֑ם וְשָׁ֣בוּ׀וְהִֽתְחַנְּנ֣וּ אֵלֶ֗יךָ בְּאֶ֤רֶץ שִׁבְיָם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר חָטָ֥אנוּ הֶעֱוִ֖ינוּ וְרָשָֽׁעְנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: and they bring back to their heart in the land where they have been taken captive there, and they turn back and plead to you in [the] land of their captivity, saying, We have sinned, we have done wrong, and we have acted wickedly,

en.L: and they bring [it] back to their heart in the land where they have been taken captive, and they turn back and plead with {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} in the land of their captivity, saying, 'We have sinned, we have done wrong, and we have acted wickedly,'
en.B: and they come to their senses in the land where they have been taken captive, and they turn back and plead with {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} in the land where they are held captive, saying, 'We have sinned; we have done wrong and acted wickedly,'
en.R: But suppose they think again about what they have done while they are in that land. Suppose they turn back to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} and beg for mercy there in the land where they are captives, saying, 'We have sinned. We have done wrong and acted wickedly.'

es.L: y vuelvan en sí en la tierra adonde fueron llevados cautivos, y se vuelvan y te supliquen en la tierra de su cautiverio, diciendo: ‘Hemos pecado, hemos hecho lo malo y hemos obrado perversamente’,
es.B: y recapaciten en la tierra adonde fueron llevados cautivos, y se vuelvan y te supliquen en la tierra donde están cautivos, diciendo: ‘Hemos pecado; hemos hecho lo malo y hemos actuado con maldad’,
es.R: Pero supongamos que piensan de nuevo en lo que han hecho mientras están en esa tierra. Supongamos que se vuelven a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} y te piden misericordia allí, en la tierra donde están cautivos, diciendo: ‘Hemos pecado. Hemos hecho lo malo y hemos actuado con maldad’.

fr.L: et qu’ils rentreront en eux-mêmes dans le pays où ils auront été emmenés captifs, et qu’ils reviendront et {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} supplieront dans le pays de leur captivité, en disant : “Nous avons péché, nous avons commis la faute, et nous avons agi méchamment”,
fr.B: s’ils rentrent en eux-mêmes dans le pays où ils auront été emmenés captifs, s’ils reviennent à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} et {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} supplient dans le pays de leur captivité, en disant : “Nous avons péché ; nous avons mal agi et nous avons été méchants”,
fr.R: Mais supposons que, dans ce pays-là, ils réfléchissent à ce qu’ils ont fait. Supposons qu’ils reviennent vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} et qu’ils {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} demandent pitié, là-bas, dans le pays où ils sont prisonniers, en disant : “Nous avons péché. Nous avons mal agi, nous avons fait le mal.”

sw.L: nao wakarudisha [hayo] mioyoni mwao katika nchi walikochukuliwa mateka, wakageuka na kukusihi katika nchi ya uhamisho wao, wakisema, 'Tumetenda dhambi, tumekosa, na tumetenda uovu,'
sw.B: nao wakapata akili tena katika nchi walikochukuliwa mateka, wakageuka na kukusihi katika nchi wanamoshikiliwa mateka, wakisema, 'Tumetenda dhambi; tumekosa na kutenda uovu,'
sw.R: Lakini tuseme wakiwa katika nchi hiyo wanafikiri tena juu ya yale waliyoyatenda. Tuseme wanakurudia na kukusihi uwahurumie huko katika nchi wanamoshikiliwa mateka, wakisema, 'Tumetenda dhambi. Tumekosa na kutenda uovu.'

vi.L: rồi họ suy nghĩ lại trong lòng tại xứ mà họ bị bắt đến, và họ quay về, nài xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tại xứ họ bị lưu đày mà rằng: 'Chúng con đã phạm tội, đã làm điều sai trái, và đã làm điều gian ác,'
vi.B: rồi tại xứ họ bị bắt đến, họ tỉnh ngộ, quay về và nài xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tại xứ họ bị giam cầm: 'Chúng con đã phạm tội; chúng con đã làm điều sai trái và gian ác,'
vi.R: Nhưng giả sử ở xứ ấy họ suy nghĩ lại về điều mình đã làm. Giả sử họ quay về với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và cầu xin thương xót ngay tại xứ họ bị bắt làm tù binh, mà nói: 'Chúng con đã phạm tội. Chúng con đã làm điều sai trái và gian ác.'

ko.L: 그들이 사로잡혀 간 땅에서 마음에 돌이켜, 그들이 사로잡혀 있는 땅에서 돌아서서 주님께 '우리가 죄를 짓고 잘못을 저질렀으며 악을 행했습니다' 하고 간구하면,
ko.B: 그들이 포로로 잡혀간 땅에서 정신을 차리고 돌이켜, 사로잡혀 있는 그 땅에서 '우리가 죄를 지었습니다. 잘못을 저지르고 악을 행했습니다' 하고 주님께 간구하면,
ko.R: 그러나 그들이 그 땅에서 자기들이 한 일을 다시 생각해 보고, 포로로 잡혀 있는 그 땅에서 주님께 돌아와 자비를 구한다고 합시다. '우리가 죄를 지었습니다. 잘못을 저지르고 악한 일을 했습니다' 하고 말하면서 말입니다.

decisions.choice: the land of their captivity: 1 Kings 8:47 has "the land of their captors"
decisions.reason: The two words look and sound alike in Hebrew. Chronicles also joins the three verbs of the confession a little differently. The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: bring back to their heart: come to their senses, take it to heart
decisions.reason: The phrase means to think again and see things as they are (Deuteronomy 4:39; 30:1).

decisions.choice: bring back ... taken captive ... turn back: a play on sounds
decisions.reason: "Turn back" and "take captive" sound alike in Hebrew. Those who were taken captive (*nishbu*) now turn back (*shavu*) to Yahweh in the land of their captivity.

decisions.choice: We have sinned, we have done wrong and acted wickedly
decisions.reason: The three verbs make a full confession. Later generations used the same words (Psalm 106:6; Daniel 9:5).

decisions.choice: "la tierra de su cautiverio" (L); "la tierra donde están cautivos" (B)
decisions.reason: Chronicles says "the land of their captivity" where 1 Kings 8:47 has "of their captors" (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: nchi ya uhamisho wao (Literal); nchi wanamoshikiliwa mateka (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Chronicles says "the land of their captivity" where 1 Kings 8:47 says "the land of their captors" (m1), so the Swahili Kings wording "nchi ya watekaji wao" is changed here.

source.text: וְשָׁ֣בוּ אֵלֶ֗יךָ בְּכָל־לִבָּם֙ וּבְכָל־נַפְשָׁ֔ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ שִׁבְיָ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־שָׁב֣וּ אֹתָ֑ם וְהִֽתְפַּֽלְל֗וּ דֶּ֤רֶךְ אַרְצָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣תָּה לַאֲבוֹתָ֔ם וְהָעִיר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחַ֔רְתָּ וְלַבַּ֖יִת אֲשֶׁר־בָּנִ֥יתִי לִשְׁמֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: and they return to you with all their heart and with all their soul in [the] land of their captivity where they took them captive, and they pray [toward the] way of their land that you gave to their fathers, and the city that you have chosen, and toward the house that I have built for your name,

en.L: and they return to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity where they took them captive, and they pray in the direction of their land that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} gave to their fathers, and the city that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have chosen, and toward the house that I have built for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name,
en.B: if they return to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} with all their heart and all their soul in the land of their captivity, where they were carried off, and pray facing their land, which {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} gave to their ancestors, and the city {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} chose, and the house I built for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name,
en.R: Suppose that there, in the land where they were taken as captives, they come back to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} with all their heart and soul. And suppose they pray facing toward their own land, the land {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} gave their ancestors, and toward the city {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} chose and the temple I built for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name.

es.L: y vuelvan a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} con todo su corazón y con toda su alma en la tierra de su cautiverio adonde los llevaron cautivos, y oren en dirección a su tierra que diste a sus padres, y a la ciudad que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has escogido, y hacia la casa que yo he edificado a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre,
es.B: si se vuelven a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} con todo su corazón y con toda su alma en la tierra de su cautiverio, adonde se los llevaron, y oran mirando hacia su tierra, que diste a sus antepasados, hacia la ciudad que escogiste y la casa que edifiqué para {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre,
es.R: Supongamos que allí, en la tierra adonde se los llevaron cautivos, se vuelven a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} con todo su corazón y con toda su alma. Y supongamos que oran mirando hacia su propia tierra, la tierra que diste a sus antepasados, y hacia la ciudad que escogiste y el templo que construí para {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre.

fr.L: et qu’ils reviendront à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} de tout leur cœur et de toute leur âme dans le pays de leur captivité où on les a emmenés captifs, et qu’ils prieront en direction de leur pays que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as donné à leurs pères, et de la ville que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as choisie, et vers la maison que j’ai bâtie pour {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom,
fr.B: s’ils reviennent à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} de tout leur cœur et de toute leur âme dans le pays de leur captivité, où on les a emmenés, et s’ils prient tournés vers leur pays, que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as donné à leurs ancêtres, vers la ville que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as choisie et vers la maison que j’ai bâtie pour {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom,
fr.R: Supposons que là-bas, dans le pays où on les a emmenés prisonniers, ils reviennent vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} de tout leur cœur et de toute leur âme. Et supposons qu’ils prient en se tournant vers leur pays, le pays que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as donné à leurs ancêtres, vers la ville que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as choisie et vers le temple que j’ai construit pour {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom.

sw.L: nao wakakurudia kwa moyo wao wote na kwa nafsi yao yote katika nchi ya uhamisho wao walikowachukua mateka, wakaomba wakielekea nchi yao uliyowapa baba zao, na mji ulioichagua, na kuelekea nyumba niliyoijenga kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}},
sw.B: wakikurudia kwa moyo wao wote na kwa roho yao yote katika nchi ya uhamisho wao walikochukuliwa, wakaomba wakielekea nchi yao uliyowapa babu zao, na mji ulioichagua, na nyumba niliyoijenga kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}},
sw.R: Tuseme huko, katika nchi walikochukuliwa mateka, wanakurudia kwa moyo wao wote na roho yao yote. Tena tuseme wanaomba wakielekea nchi yao wenyewe, nchi uliyowapa babu zao, na kuelekea mji ulioichagua na hekalu nililojenga kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}.

vi.L: và họ hết lòng hết linh hồn trở về với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tại xứ họ bị lưu đày, nơi người ta đã bắt họ đến, và cầu nguyện hướng về xứ của họ mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban cho tổ phụ họ, về thành {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chọn, và về nhà con đã xây cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},
vi.B: nếu họ hết lòng hết linh hồn trở về với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tại xứ họ bị giam cầm, nơi họ bị bắt đến, và cầu nguyện hướng về xứ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban cho tổ tiên họ, về thành {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chọn và nhà con đã xây cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},
vi.R: Giả sử tại xứ họ bị bắt đến làm tù binh, họ hết lòng hết linh hồn trở về với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Và giả sử họ cầu nguyện hướng về xứ của họ, là xứ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban cho tổ tiên họ, về thành {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chọn và đền thờ con đã xây cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그들이 사로잡혀 간 땅, 곧 그들을 사로잡아 간 곳에서 온 마음과 온 영혼으로 주님께 돌아와, 주님께서 그들의 조상들에게 주신 그들의 땅과 주님께서 택하신 성읍과 제가 주님의 이름을 위하여 지은 집 쪽을 향하여 기도하면,
ko.B: 그들이 끌려간 포로의 땅에서 온 마음과 온 영혼으로 주님께 돌아와, 주님께서 그들의 조상들에게 주신 땅과 주님께서 택하신 성읍과 제가 주님의 이름을 위하여 지은 집을 향하여 기도하면,
ko.R: 그들이 포로로 끌려간 그 땅에서 온 마음과 정성을 다해 주님께로 돌아온다고 합시다. 그리고 주님께서 그들의 조상들에게 주신 땅과 주님께서 택하신 성읍과 제가 주님의 이름을 위하여 지은 성전을 향해 기도한다고 합시다.

decisions.choice: small differences from 1 Kings 8:48
decisions.reason: Kings says "in the land of their enemies who took them captive" and "they pray to you toward their land". Chronicles says "in the land of their captivity where they took them captive" and "they pray toward their land". The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: return to you with all their heart and all their soul
decisions.reason: Moses promised that if Israel in exile returned to Yahweh with all their heart and soul, he would have mercy and gather them again (Deuteronomy 4:29-31; 30:1-3).

decisions.choice: pray toward their land, the city and the house
decisions.reason: Exiles far from home would pray facing Jerusalem, as Daniel did (Daniel 6:11). The three goals, land, city and house, narrow down to the place where Yahweh's name is.

decisions.choice: where they took them captive: the captors are not named
decisions.reason: "They" here are those who carried Israel off, as the context shows.

decisions.choice: where they were carried off (Balanced); where they were taken as captives (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable turn the unnamed "they" into a passive, so that it is not mistaken for Israel.

decisions.choice: "nơi họ bị bắt đến" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The captors of "where they took them captive" are not named (m4); Balanced and Readable turn it into a passive so that "họ" is not taken for Israel's own act.

source.text: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ֨מִן־הַשָּׁמַ֜יִם מִמְּכ֣וֹן שִׁבְתְּךָ֗ אֶת־תְּפִלָּתָם֙ וְאֶת־תְּחִנֹּ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם וְעָשִׂ֖יתָ מִשְׁפָּטָ֑ם וְסָלַחְתָּ֥ לְעַמְּךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָֽטְאוּ־לָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: and hear from the heavens, from [the] place of your dwelling, their prayer and their pleas, and do their justice, and forgive your people who have sinned against you.

en.L: then hear from the heavens, from the place of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} dwelling, their prayer and their pleas, and uphold their cause, and forgive {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people who have sinned against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: then hear from heaven, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} dwelling place, their prayer and their pleas, uphold their cause, and forgive {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people who have sinned against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: then listen from heaven, where {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} live, to their prayer and their requests, and stand up for them. Forgive {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people who have sinned against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

es.L: escucha desde los cielos, desde el lugar de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} morada, su oración y sus súplicas, y haz su justicia, y perdona a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo que ha pecado contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.B: escucha entonces desde el cielo, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} morada, su oración y sus súplicas, defiende su causa y perdona a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo que ha pecado contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.R: entonces escucha desde el cielo, donde {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} vives, su oración y sus peticiones, y ponte de su lado. Perdona a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo que ha pecado contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

fr.L: alors écoute depuis les cieux, depuis le lieu de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} demeure, leur prière et leurs supplications, et fais-leur droit, et pardonne à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple qui a péché contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.B: alors écoute du ciel, le lieu de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} demeure, leur prière et leurs supplications, défends leur cause, et pardonne à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple qui a péché contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.R: Alors écoute du ciel, où {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} habites, leur prière et leurs demandes, et prends leur défense. Pardonne à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple qui a péché contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

sw.L: basi usikie kutoka mbinguni, kutoka mahali pa makao {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, sala yao na dua zao, ukawapatie haki yao, ukawasamehe watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} waliokutenda dhambi.
sw.B: basi usikie kutoka mbinguni, makao {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, sala yao na dua zao, ukawapatie haki yao, ukawasamehe watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} waliokutenda dhambi.
sw.R: basi sikiliza kutoka mbinguni unakoishi sala yao na maombi yao, ukawatetee. Uwasamehe watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} waliokutenda dhambi.

vi.L: thì xin nghe từ trời, từ nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngự, lời cầu nguyện và các lời nài xin của họ, xin bênh vực lẽ phải của họ, và tha thứ cho dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phạm tội với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: thì xin từ trời, nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngự, nghe lời cầu nguyện và các lời nài xin của họ, bênh vực lẽ phải của họ, và tha thứ cho dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phạm tội với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: thì xin từ trời, nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngự, lắng nghe lời cầu nguyện và những lời xin của họ, và xin đứng về phía họ. Xin tha thứ cho dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phạm tội với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 주님께서는 하늘에서, 주님께서 계시는 곳에서 그들의 기도와 간구를 들으시고 그들의 정의를 세워 주시며, 주님께 죄를 지은 주님의 백성을 용서해 주십시오.
ko.B: 주님께서는 주님께서 계시는 하늘에서 그들의 기도와 간구를 들으시고 그들의 사정을 돌보아 주십시오. 그리고 주님께 죄를 지은 주님의 백성을 용서해 주십시오.
ko.R: 주님께서는 주님께서 계시는 하늘에서 그들의 기도와 간구를 들으시고 그들 편이 되어 주십시오. 주님께 죄를 지은 주님의 백성을 용서해 주십시오.

decisions.choice: the end of the requests: 1 Kings 8:49-53 goes on
decisions.reason: Kings has "hear [in] the heavens" and goes on to ask forgiveness for "all their transgressions", that their captors would show them compassion, and recalls the exodus (1 Kings 8:50-53). Chronicles ends the request with forgiveness and turns to the close of the prayer in verses 40-42.

decisions.choice: uphold their cause: take their side and set them right
decisions.reason: As in verse 35. Here it means restoring the captives, whose cause Yahweh takes up once they have turned back.

decisions.choice: hear from heaven, your dwelling place
decisions.reason: As in verse 30.

source.text: עַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֗י יִֽהְיוּ־נָ֤א עֵינֶ֨יךָ֙ פְּתֻח֔וֹת וְאָזְנֶ֖יךָ קַשֻּׁב֑וֹת לִתְפִלַּ֖ת הַמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Now, my God, let be, please, your eyes open and your ears attentive to [the] prayer of the place the this.

en.L: Now, my God, please let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} eyes be open and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} ears attentive to the prayer of this place.
en.B: Now, my God, please let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} eyes be open and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} ears attentive to the prayer that is prayed in this place.
en.R: Now, my God, please keep {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} eyes open and listen carefully to every prayer made in this place.

es.L: Ahora, Dios mío, te ruego que estén {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} ojos abiertos y {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} oídos atentos a la oración de este lugar.
es.B: Ahora, Dios mío, te ruego que {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} ojos estén abiertos y {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} oídos atentos a la oración que se haga en este lugar.
es.R: Ahora, Dios mío, te ruego que mantengas {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} ojos abiertos y escuches con atención cada oración que se haga en este lugar.

fr.L: Maintenant, mon Dieu, que {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} yeux soient ouverts, je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}en prie, et {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} oreilles attentives à la prière de ce lieu.
fr.B: Maintenant, mon Dieu, je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}en prie, que {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} yeux soient ouverts et {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} oreilles attentives à la prière qui se fait en ce lieu.
fr.R: Maintenant, mon Dieu, s’il {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} plaît, garde les yeux ouverts et écoute bien chaque prière faite en ce lieu.

sw.L: Sasa, Mungu wangu, tafadhali macho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} na yawe wazi, na masikio {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yawe makini kwa sala ya mahali hapa.
sw.B: Sasa, Mungu wangu, tafadhali macho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} na yawe wazi, na masikio {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yasikilize kwa makini sala inayoombwa mahali hapa.
sw.R: Sasa, Mungu wangu, tafadhali uyafungue macho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, usikilize kwa makini kila sala inayoombwa mahali hapa.

vi.L: Bây giờ, lạy Đức Chúa Trời của con, xin mắt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mở ra và tai {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lắng nghe lời cầu nguyện tại nơi này.
vi.B: Bây giờ, lạy Đức Chúa Trời của con, xin mắt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mở ra và tai {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chú ý lắng nghe lời cầu nguyện được dâng lên tại nơi này.
vi.R: Bây giờ, lạy Đức Chúa Trời của con, xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} luôn mở mắt và lắng tai nghe mọi lời cầu nguyện được dâng lên tại nơi này.

ko.L: 이제 제 하나님, 부디 주님의 눈이 열려 있고 주님의 귀가 이곳의 기도에 기울어져 있게 해 주십시오.
ko.B: 이제 제 하나님, 이곳에서 드리는 기도에 부디 눈을 뜨시고 귀를 기울여 주십시오.
ko.R: 이제 제 하나님, 부디 이곳에서 드리는 모든 기도를 지켜보시고 귀 기울여 들어 주십시오.

decisions.choice: a different ending from 1 Kings 8:51-53
decisions.reason: Kings ends with Israel as Yahweh's people brought out of Egypt and asks that his eyes be open to their pleas (1 Kings 8:51-53). Chronicles asks that his eyes be open and his ears attentive to prayer in this place, and Yahweh answers with these very words in 7:15. The words "let your ears be attentive" are also in Psalm 130:2 and Nehemiah 1:6, 11.

decisions.choice: the prayer of this place: prayer made in it or toward it
decisions.reason: The phrase is short for every prayer that is prayed at the house or toward it (verses 20-39).

decisions.choice: eyes open and ears attentive: watching and listening with care
decisions.reason: Yahweh's open eyes and listening ears mean that he notices and answers (verse 20).

decisions.choice: the prayer that is prayed in this place (Balanced); every prayer made in this place (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "the prayer of this place" means. Readable puts "attentive ears" as listening carefully.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֗ה קוּמָ֞ה יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ לְֽנוּחֶ֔ךָ אַתָּ֖ה וַאֲר֣וֹן עֻזֶּ֑ךָ כֹּהֲנֶ֜יךָ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ יִלְבְּשׁ֣וּ תְשׁוּעָ֔ה וַחֲסִידֶ֖יךָ יִשְׂמְח֥וּ בַטּֽוֹב׃

records.literal_gloss: And now, arise, Yahweh God, to your resting place, you and [the] ark of your strength; your priests, Yahweh God, let them be clothed [with] salvation, and your faithful ones let them rejoice in the good.

en.L: And now, arise, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} God, to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} resting place, \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} and the ark of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} strength. \q Let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} priests, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} God, be clothed [with] salvation, \q and let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful ones rejoice in [what is] good.
en.B: And now rise up, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} God! Come to the place where {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will rest, \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} and the ark of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} might. \q Let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} priests, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} God, be dressed in salvation, \q and let those loyal to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} rejoice in good things.
en.R: And now get up, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} God! Come to the place where {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will rest. \q Come with the ark that shows how strong {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are. \q {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} God, may {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} priests wear {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} salvation like clothing. \q May {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful people be glad for the good things {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} give them.

es.L: Y ahora, levántate, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios, hacia {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} lugar de reposo, \q {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} y el arca de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} poder. \q Que {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} sacerdotes, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios, se vistan [de] salvación, \q y que {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} fieles se alegren en el bien.
es.B: ¡Y ahora álzate, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios! Ven al lugar donde {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} descansarás, \q {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} y el arca de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fuerza. \q Que {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} sacerdotes, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios, se vistan de salvación, \q y que los que te son leales se alegren en lo bueno.
es.R: ¡Y ahora ponte en marcha, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios! Ven al lugar donde {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} vas a descansar. \q Ven con el arca que muestra lo fuerte que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres. \q {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios, que {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} sacerdotes lleven {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} salvación como si fuera su ropa. \q Que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo fiel se alegre por las cosas buenas que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} le das.

fr.L: Et maintenant, lève-toi, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} Dieu, vers {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} lieu de repos, \q {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} et l’arche de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} force. \q Que {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} prêtres, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} Dieu, soient revêtus de salut, \q et que {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} fidèles se réjouissent dans le bien.
fr.B: Et maintenant, lève-toi, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} Dieu ! Viens au lieu où {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} reposeras, \q {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} et l’arche de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} puissance. \q Que {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} prêtres, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} Dieu, soient vêtus de salut, \q et que ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} sont fidèles se réjouissent de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} bienfaits.
fr.R: Et maintenant, debout, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} Dieu ! Viens à l’endroit où {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} vas {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} reposer. \q Viens avec l’arche qui montre combien {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es fort. \q {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} Dieu, que {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} prêtres portent {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} salut comme un vêtement. \q Que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple fidèle se réjouisse des bonnes choses que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} lui donnes.

sw.L: Basi sasa, inuka, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu, [uje] mahali pa pumziko {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, \q {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} na sanduku la nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}. \q Makuhani {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu, na wavikwe wokovu, \q na waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wafurahie mema.
sw.B: Basi sasa inuka, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu! Uje mahali utakapopumzika, \q {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} na sanduku la uweza {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}. \q Makuhani {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu, na wavae wokovu, \q na wale walio waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}} wafurahie mema.
sw.R: Basi sasa simama, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu! Njoo mahali utakapopumzika. \q Njoo pamoja na sanduku linaloonyesha jinsi ulivyo na nguvu. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu, makuhani {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} na wauvae wokovu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} kama nguo. \q Watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} waaminifu na wafurahie mema unayowapa.

vi.L: Vậy bây giờ, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời, xin đứng dậy [mà vào] nơi nghỉ ngơi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và hòm của sức mạnh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời, nguyện các thầy tế lễ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được mặc [lấy] sự cứu rỗi, \q và nguyện những người trung tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vui mừng trong [điều] tốt lành.
vi.B: Vậy bây giờ, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời, xin trỗi dậy! Xin đến nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ nghỉ ngơi, \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cùng với hòm của quyền năng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời, nguyện các thầy tế lễ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được mặc lấy sự cứu rỗi, \q và nguyện những người trung thành với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vui mừng trong những điều tốt lành.
vi.R: Vậy bây giờ, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời, xin hãy đứng lên! Xin đến nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ nghỉ ngơi. \q Xin đến cùng với hòm là dấu chứng tỏ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mạnh mẽ biết bao. \q Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời, nguyện các thầy tế lễ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mặc lấy sự cứu rỗi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} như áo. \q Nguyện dân trung tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vui mừng vì những điều tốt lành {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ban cho họ.

ko.L: 그리고 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 하나님, 일어나셔서 주님의 안식처로 [가십시오], \q 주님과 주님의 능력의 궤가 함께. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 하나님, 주님의 제사장들이 구원을 옷 입게 하시고, \q 주님의 신실한 자들이 좋은 것으로 기뻐하게 하십시오.
ko.B: 그리고 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 하나님, 일어나십시오! 주님께서 쉬실 곳으로 오십시오. \q 주님과 주님의 힘이 깃든 궤가 함께 오십시오. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 하나님, 주님의 제사장들이 구원으로 옷 입게 하시고, \q 주님께 충성하는 이들이 좋은 것으로 기뻐하게 하여 주십시오.
ko.R: 그리고 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 하나님, 일어나십시오! 주님께서 쉬실 곳으로 오십시오. \q 주님께서 얼마나 강하신지 보여 주는 궤와 함께 오십시오. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 하나님, 주님의 제사장들이 주님의 구원을 옷처럼 입게 하여 주십시오. \q 주님의 신실한 백성이 주님께서 주시는 좋은 것으로 기뻐하게 하여 주십시오.

decisions.choice: Psalm 132:8-9 with differences
decisions.reason: Solomon ends his prayer with words found in Psalm 132:8-9. Chronicles adds "And now" and "God" after Yahweh's name (twice), and uses a shorter word for "resting place". The Psalm asks that the priests be clothed with "righteousness" and that the faithful "shout for joy"; here they are to be clothed with "salvation", as Yahweh promises in Psalm 132:16, and to "rejoice in what is good". Where the words are the same, the wording is the same as in Psalm 132.

decisions.choice: Arise, Yahweh, to your resting place: the ark comes to rest
decisions.reason: "Arise, Yahweh" was said when the ark set out in the wilderness (Numbers 10:35). Now the ark has been brought into the house (5:7), its lasting home; David had planned "a house of rest for the ark" (1 Chronicles 28:2).

decisions.choice: the ark of your strength: the sign of your power
decisions.reason: The ark went before Israel in battle and showed Yahweh's power (Psalm 78:61; 1 Samuel 4-6).

decisions.choice: clothed with salvation: marked by Yahweh's help
decisions.reason: Being clothed with a quality means it covers the person and can be seen (Isaiah 61:10). The priests are to show the salvation, the rescue and well-being, that Yahweh gives.

decisions.choice: faithful ones; the good
decisions.reason: The faithful (*chasidim*) are those loyal to Yahweh and his covenant; the word comes from *chesed*, loyal love. "The good" is the good that Yahweh gives his people, their blessing and well-being (Nehemiah 9:25, 35).

decisions.choice: Arise (Literal); Rise up (Balanced); Get up (Readable); LORD God
decisions.reason: As in Psalm 132:8. The divine name is called on directly, so it has no "the" before it, as in the Psalm.

decisions.choice: the good things you give them (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says where the good comes from, as the Psalm's promise does (Psalm 132:15-16).

decisions.choice: wording of the Spanish Psalm 132:8-9 kept, with "salvación"
decisions.reason: The verse takes up Psalm 132:8-9 (meaning decision); the published Spanish Psalm wording is kept at each level wherever the Hebrew is the same, and changed where Chronicles has "salvation" and "rejoice in the good".

decisions.choice: the wording of the published French Psalm 132:8-9, changed only where Chronicles differs
decisions.reason: Solomon closes with the words of Psalm 132:8-10 (m1); French keeps the Psalm's "Lève-toi" (L, B), "Debout" (R), "l'arche de ta force / puissance" and "tes fidèles", and changes "justice" to "salut" and "crient de joie" to "se réjouissent dans le bien", as the Hebrew of Chronicles does.

decisions.choice: inuka ... mahali pa pumziko lako (Literal); inuka ... uje mahali utakapopumzika (Balanced); simama ... njoo mahali utakapopumzika (Readable)
decisions.reason: Solomon quotes Psalm 132:8-9, and the Swahili keeps the wording of its published Psalm 132 at each level, changing only what Chronicles changes ("Yahweh God", "salvation" for "righteousness", "rejoice in what is good").

decisions.choice: the wording of the published Psalm 132:8-9; "sự cứu rỗi" where the Psalm has "sự công chính"
decisions.reason: Solomon's closing words are Psalm 132:8-10 with differences (m1); the Psalm's Vietnamese is kept where the Hebrew is the same, and the lines follow the English line breaks.

decisions.choice: The wording of the published Psalm 132:8-9, changed where Chronicles changes it ("{{divine_name:주|야훼}} 하나님", "구원", "좋은 것")
decisions.reason: The verse quotes Psalm 132:8-9 with differences (m1); Korean reuses the Psalm's lines and follows Chronicles' Hebrew where it differs.

decisions.choice: Psalm 132:10 with differences
decisions.reason: The Psalm reads: "For the sake of David your servant, do not turn away the face of your anointed." Chronicles adds "Yahweh God", puts the request about the anointed first, and in place of "for the sake of David" asks Yahweh to "remember the steadfast love of David". The same words, "the steadfast love of David", stand in Isaiah 55:3.

decisions.choice: your anointed ones (plural)
decisions.reason: The Leningrad text has the plural, "your anointed ones": the kings of David's line, Solomon and those after him. Many Hebrew manuscripts, the Greek translation, and Psalm 132:10 have the singular, "your anointed", meaning the reigning king, here Solomon himself. The difference is one letter. The meaning is close: in both, the king of David's line asks not to be refused.

decisions.choice: turn away the face: refuse a request
decisions.reason: To turn away someone's face is to send them away with their request refused (1 Kings 2:16-20).

decisions.choice: the steadfast love of David: love shown to David
decisions.reason: The phrase can mean the steadfast love Yahweh showed and promised to David, his lasting promise of a king on the throne (1 Chronicles 17:13; Psalm 89:2-5, 50; Isaiah 55:3). It can also mean David's own loyal deeds for Yahweh, as Chronicles uses the plural of this word for the good deeds of Hezekiah and Josiah (32:32; 35:26). Since the prayer has asked Yahweh to keep his promise to David (verses 15-17), the first sense is taken.

decisions.choice: steadfast love (plural): acts of loyal love
decisions.reason: *Chesed* is the loyal, generous love that keeps its commitments. The plural speaks of its many acts or promises.

decisions.choice: acts of steadfast love, slave (Literal); faithful love, servant (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: *Chesed* is "steadfast love" at Literal and "faithful love" at Balanced and Readable, as in verse 14; Literal shows the plural with "acts of" and keeps the phrase open to both readings. "Your servant" follows the rule for *'eved* as in verses 15-17, so Literal has "slave" here, where Psalm 132:10 has "servant" at every level.

decisions.choice: the kings you have anointed (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say who the anointed are, as Psalm 132:10 does for the singular.

decisions.choice: "tus ungidos" (L); "los reyes que tú has ungido" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has the plural "your anointed ones" (meaning decision); the wording of the Spanish Psalm 132:10 is kept in the plural.

decisions.choice: "los actos de amor leal" (L); "amor fiel" (B, R); "siervo" at every level
decisions.reason: *Ḥesed* in the plural is acts of loyal love (meaning decision); David is God's "siervo" at every level, as in Psalm 132:10.

decisions.choice: "David ton serviteur" at Literal
decisions.reason: David, named, is "serviteur" at every level, as in French Kings and the Psalm; the English Literal says "slave".

decisions.choice: masihi wako (Literal); wafalme uliowatia mafuta (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal says "masihi", the word the Samuel terms note keeps for the LORD's anointed; Balanced and Readable say who the anointed are, in the words of the Swahili Psalm 132:10.

decisions.choice: "những việc yêu thương thành tín" (L); "tình yêu thương thành tín" (B, R); "đầy tớ" at every level
decisions.reason: Literal shows the Hebrew plural of *ḥesed* (m5); David is God's "đầy tớ" at every level, as in Psalm 132:10.

decisions.choice: "기름 부음 받은 이들" (L), "주님께서 기름 부으신 왕들" (B, R); "한결같은 사랑" (L), "인애" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As Psalm 132:10 and the Samuel terms note, in the plural Chronicles reads (m2).
